He recorded another game's interface as a reference and talked over it. Lane uiref1 turned his words and the
recording into a spec and a working mock:

- **`unreal\megajam-2026\lanes\uiref1\UI_SPEC.md` is your spec. Read it in full first.** Section 12 lists each of

  sizes, timings and states are in it. `HANDOFF.md` there lists its checks.

The points he was firmest on: no rounded corners anywhere; a clear font; a sound on every hover and every click;
"a highlight glow and an outline on everything"; important buttons textured; our own colours and background; the
pause menu "should come out from the left" as "a simple settings menu where you can leave game, restart run,
settings"; controls live inside settings, not on a screen of their own; **"I want full crosshair customization"**;
sensitivity and key bindings; colour-blind mode; motion blur; separate volumes plus master, output mode, mute when
minimised; "video is important... we need most of these settings"; no FSR.

# Unreal Engine instructions

Shared by Claude Code (through `CLAUDE.md`, which imports this file) and Codex.

This folder holds everything the studio learns and plans about Unreal Engine. It exists so Unreal
notes never mix with the [another platform] Studio notes in the parent folder (owner, 12 Nov 2026).

| File | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `GOTCHAS.md` | Traps: things that broke or will break, with the fix. Read before any Unreal work. |

18	
19	### Units
20	- Positions and sizes are fractions of screen width **W** or height **H**. Everything scales with H, as the HUD does
21	  today (`S = H / 720`). At 16:9, 1 W = 1.778 H.
22	- Text size is given as **cap height / H**. For the canvas `Label` call: font size in pixels is about
23	  `cap / 0.71 * H` for Roboto Bold (the engine's medium font) **[pick: measure once in game and correct the 0.71]**.
24	  Example: cap 0.020 H at 1440p is 28.8 px of cap, size 40.
25	- Frames are at 60 fps: 1 f = 16.7 ms. Times in the spec are in ms, frames in brackets when measured.
26	- Easing names: **out** = cubic ease-out `1-(1-t)^3`; **in** = `t^3`; **inout** = smoothstep `t*t*(3-2t)`;
27	  **snap** = 0 ms.
28	
29	### Colour roles
30	SUPERCUT spends four hues on world signals (GAME.md): red-orange **danger**, green **the way on**, yellow **the
31	player's shots**, cyan **frozen time**. The interface uses them only to carry that same meaning, never as chrome.

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "InputCoreTypes.h"
#include "Subsystems/WorldSubsystem.h"
#include "SupercutMenu.generated.h"

enum class ESupercutScreen : uint8
{
	None,       // no menu: the game, or the upgrade or wrap screen, has the keys
	Title,      // START, CONTROLS, SETTINGS, QUIT
	Pause,      // RESUME, RESTART RUN, CONTROLS, SETTINGS, QUIT TO TITLE, QUIT GAME
	Settings,   // SENSITIVITY, VOLUME, QUALITY, DISPLAY, BACK
	Controls,   // the key list, BACK
};

enum class ESupercutRow : uint8
{
	Start,
	Resume,
	RestartRun,
	Controls,
	Settings,
	QuitToTitle,
	QuitGame,
	Sensitivity,
	Volume,
	Quality,
	Display,
	Back,
};

/**
 * The title, pause, settings and controls screens. The HUD draws them and the player controller hands
 * them its keys and clicks; this object holds which screen is up, which row is chosen, and what each
 * row does.
 *
 * Keys: W S or the up and down arrows move, Enter or Space chooses, A D or the left and right arrows
 * change a value, Esc goes back. On SENSITIVITY and VOLUME the digits (and the point, for SENSITIVITY) type a value:
 * Enter sets it, Backspace takes a character off, Esc or any other key drops it. Esc in a room, on the upgrade screen, on the wrap screen or on the
 * death screen opens the pause screen, and Esc there resumes. Esc never quits the program.
 *
 * The pause screen pauses the world (APlayerController::SetPause): actors, the freeze clock and the
 * run stop, and the engine pauses every sound that is not a UI sound.
 */
UCLASS()
class USupercutMenu : public UWorldSubsystem
{
	GENERATED_BODY()

public:
	/** The menu of the world this object lives in. Fails loudly if there is none. */
	static USupercutMenu& Get(const UObject* WorldContext);

	bool IsOpen() const { return Screen != ESupercutScreen::None; }
	ESupercutScreen GetScreen() const { return Screen; }
	/** The rows of the screen that is up, top to bottom. */
	const TArray<ESupercutRow>& GetRows() const;
	int32 GetSelected() const { return Selected; }

	/** The run is at its title: the title screen goes up and the world pauses. */
	void ShowTitle();

	/** One key press. With no menu up only Esc counts: it opens the pause screen in a run. */
	void PressKey(const FKey& Key);
	/** The mouse is over row Index of the screen that is up. */
	void Hover(int32 Index);
	/** A left click on row Index. bLower: on the left half of a value, which steps it down. */
	void Click(

	using ERow = ESupercutRow;

	const TArray<ERow> MenuPauseRows = { ERow::Resume, ERow::RestartRun, ERow::Controls, ERow::Settings, ERow::QuitToTitle, ERow::QuitGame };
	const TArray<ERow> MenuSettingsRows = { ERow::Sensitivity, ERow::Volume, ERow::Quality, ERow::Display, ERow::Back };

	const TCHAR* MenuScreenName(ESupercutScreen Screen)
	{
		switch (Screen)
		{
		case ESupercutScreen::Title: return TEXT("title");
		case ESupercutScreen::Pause: return TEXT("pause");
		case ESupercutScreen::Settings: return TEXT("settings");
		case ESupercutScreen::Controls: return TEXT("controls");
		default: return TEXT("none");
		}
	}

	void MenuSetWorldPaused(const UObject* Context, bool bPaused)
	{
		APlayerController* Controller = Context->GetWorld()->GetFirstPlayerController();
		checkf(Controller, TEXT("USupercutMenu: the world has no player controller to pause it"));
		Controller->SetPause(bPaused);
	}
}

USupercutMenu& USupercutMenu::Get(const UObject* WorldContext)
{
	check(WorldContext);
	UWorld* World = WorldContext->GetWorld();
	checkf(World, TEXT("USupercutMenu::Get: %s has no world"), *WorldContext->GetName());
	USupercutMenu* Menu = World->GetSubsystem<USupercutMenu>();
	checkf(Menu, TEXT("USupercutMenu::Get: world %s has no menu"), *World->GetName());
	return *Menu;
}

const TArray<ESupercutRow>& USupercutMenu::GetRows() const
{
	switch (Screen)
	{
	case ESupercutScreen::Title: return MenuTitleRows;
	case ESupercutScreen::Pause: return MenuPauseRows;
	case ESupercutScreen::Settings: return MenuSettingsRows;
	case ESupercutScreen::Controls: return MenuControlsRows;
	default: return MenuNoRows;
	}
}

void USupercutMenu::Open(ESupercutScreen NewScreen, int32 NewSelected)
{
	Typed.Reset();
	Screen = NewScreen;
	Selected = NewSelected;
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("MENU %s"), MenuScreenName(Screen));
}

/**
 * Turns keys and the mouse into one FSupercutInput a frame and hands it to the character.
 * Keys are read directly (W A S D, Space, mouse buttons, R, Esc), so the game needs no input assets.
 * On the upgrade screen it takes keys 1, 2, 3 or a click on a card. On the wrap screen any key but Esc starts a new run.
 * Esc opens the pause screen; the title, pause, settings and controls screens (USupercutMenu) take the keys and clicks first.
 *
 * Switches, read from the command line in every build (Shipping too, so its build can be checked with a script):
 *   -SupercutScript=<file>  a scripted player: a text file of timed inputs replaces the keyboard and mouse
 *   -SupercutShots=<folder> the script's "shot <name>" lines save <folder>/<name>.png
 *   -SupercutFps            log the frame rate, split into rolling and frozen time
 *   -SupercutQuit           quit when the script ends (exit code 0), or when it fails (exit code 2)
 *   -SupercutTrace          log the player's place, view, rounds and charges twice a second (for checking real keys and mouse)
 *
 * Script lines are "<seconds> <command> [words]". The clock starts when the script does and runs
 * through the upgrade and wrap screens. A "scene" line sets it back to zero. Commands:
 *   move <forward> <right>   hold the move keys (-1 to 1 each) until the next move line
 *   look <yaw> <pitch>       point the view (degrees)
 *   lookat <x> <y> <z>       point the view at a place in the room
 *   aim <enemy index>        point the view at an enemy's chest. Enemies of every kind are numbered 0, 1, 2 in the order of their room file lines
 *   jump | fire | clap | reload   one press
 *   firehold <0 or 1>        hold or release the trigger
 *   key <key name>           press and let go of a real key, by the engine's name for it (One, Two, Three, SpaceBar, ...)
 *   click <x> <y>            a mouse click at a place on the screen, each 0 to 1 from the top left. The menu screens and the upgrade screen take clicks.
 *   scene <n> [take]         wait until the run enters its next room, check it is scene n (and that take), set the clock to 0.

# farm.sh: build, test, package and run a SUPERCUT project copy on a farm PC, driven from c4. Details: ../FARM.md.
#
#   farm.sh mirror  <host> <name> <project folder on c4>     copy the project to <root>\Farm\<name> (changed files only)
#   farm.sh build   <host> <name> <log folder> [build.ps1 args, e.g. -Target Supercut -Jobs 8]
#   farm.sh test    <host> <name> <log folder> [run_tests.ps1 args, e.g. -Filter Supercut.Rooms]
#   farm.sh package <host> <name> <log folder>               Tools\package.cmd   -> <root>\Farm\_builds\<name>\Supercut59

}

# Runs the scripted player in a real game window and waits for it to quit.
# Default: the uncooked project through the editor exe. With -Packaged: the packaged game.
# Usage: powershell -File Tools\run_demo.ps1 [-Shots <folder>] [-ResX 1280] [-ResY 720] [-Script <file>]
#        [-Room <name>] [-Run <name>] [-Seed <n>] [-Log <file>] [-TimeoutSeconds 240] [-NoQuit] [-Packaged [-Exe <packaged Supercut.exe>]]
#        [-FixedFps <n>] [-Silent] [-Record <file.wav>] [-Upgrades <name>,<name>] [-Dev] [-Title] [-Shipping]
# Exit code: 0 the script finished, 2 the script failed (the player died when the script did not expect it,
# or a "scene" step did not see its room), 3 the game was stopped at the timeout.
param(
    [string]$Shots = "$(Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)\Saved\shots",
    [int]$ResX = 1280,
    [int]$ResY = 720,
    [string]$Script = "$(Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)\Script\demo.txt",
    [string]$Room = "",   # play one room, Content\Rooms\<name>.txt, as a run of its own
    [string]$Run = "",    # play the run list Content\Runs\<name>.txt instead of main.txt
    [int]$Seed = -1,      # the seed that decides which upgrades are offered; -1 leaves it to the game
    [string]$Log = "$(Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)\Saved\Logs\demo.log",
    [int]$TimeoutSeconds = 240,
    [switch]$NoQuit,   # leave out -SupercutQuit: the game keeps running after the script and is stopped at the timeout
    [int]$FixedFps = 0, # above 0: every frame advances game time by exactly 1/FixedFps s, whatever the PC's load, so a script gives the same result each run
    [switch]$Packaged, # run the packaged game instead of the uncooked project
    [string]$Exe = "D:\UE\Builds\Supercut59\Windows\Supercut.exe",  # with -Packaged: which packaged game to run
    [switch]$Silent,   # render the sound without sending it to the speakers (the engine's deterministic offline audio device)
    [string]$Record = "",  # write the master output to this .wav (also silent); record at real speed, without -FixedFps
    [string]$Upgrades = "",  # every take starts holding these upgrades, by the names PICK lines print: doubleexposure,longtake
    [switch]$Dev,      # -SupercutDev: the practice keys F1-F6 and F9 (a script presses them with "key F2")
    [switch]$Title,    # -SupercutTitle: start at the title screen although a script is given (the script presses START)

## SUPERCUT core lane (13 Nov 2026, c4, engine 5.8.4)

All verified on c4 in the project at `D:\UE\Projects\Supercut` unless marked `docs`.

- **A compile can die with `C1001: Internal compiler error` and no source line when memory is
  short** (verified). The first build of a 12-file module failed on most files with
  `c1xx: fatal error C1001 (compiler file 'msc1.cpp', line 1589)`. c4 had 5.9 GB of 31 GB free.
  UBT starts one compile per core and each maps the shared precompiled header. Fix: add
  `-MaxParallelActions=3` to the `Build.bat` line. Through UAT the same switch goes in as
  `-ubtargs=-MaxParallelActions=3`.
- **A local variable named `Player` inside an `APlayerController` subclass breaks the build**
  (verified): `error C4458: declaration of 'Player' hides class member`. The class has a member
  called `Player`, and the engine builds with that warning as an error. Use another name.
- **A clean exit returns 0 on Windows whatever code you ask for** (verified, and read in
  `WindowsPlatformMisc.cpp`). `FPlatformMisc::RequestExitWithStatus(false, 2)` posts the code with
  `PostQuitMessage`, and the launcher's main loop returns its own value. A scripted run that
  logged an error and asked for code 2 came back as 0. With `Force` true the engine flushes the
  log and calls `TerminateProcess` with the code, and the caller sees 2. The engine's own
  automation quit does the same.
- **The first screenshot of a run stalls the game, and the world clock only moves 0.4 s for it**
  (verified, three runs out of three). `FScreenshotRequest::RequestScreenshot` on the first call
  froze the window for longer than 0.4 s. `AWorldSettings::FixupDeltaSeconds` clamps a frame to
  `MaxUndilatedFrameTime`, so game time jumped by exactly 0.40. Later screenshots cost a few
  frames. For a timed script: take one throwaway picture early, and leave 0.3 s between a
  picture and any step whose timing matters.
- **Colour grading by brightness cannot keep glows in colour while the room goes grey**
  (verified by picture). `ColorSaturationShadows` and `ColorSaturationMidtones` at 0.18 with
  `ColorSaturationHighlights` at 1 and `ColorCorrectionHighlightsMin/Max` at 1 and 2 left the
  glowing shots pale. The grading reads luminance after exposure
  (`PostProcessCombineLUTs.usf`, `ColorCorrectAll`), and a lit floor is as bright there as a
  modest emissive. What worked: change the surface colours themselves. Every lit surface is a
  dynamic material instance with a `Color` par

void USupercutMenu::Commit(ESupercutRow Row, const FString& Before)
{
	USupercutUserSettings& Settings = USupercutUserSettings::Get();
	const FString After = RowValue(Row);
	if (After == Before)
	{
		return;   // at the end of its range
	}
	Settings.ApplyAndSave(Row == ERow::Display);
	if (Row == ERow::Volume)
	{
		USupercutAudio::Get(this).SetMasterVolume(Settings.GetVolume() / 100.f);
	}
	PlayCue(TEXT("ui_pick"));
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("MENU set %s %s to %s"), *RowLabel(Row, Screen), *Before, *After);
}

bool USupercutMenu::Type(const FKey& Key)
{
	if (Type(Key))
	{
		return;
	}
	if (IsTyping())
	{
		// Enter sets the typed value and Esc drops it, and neither does more. Any other key drops it and does its job.
		StopTyping(Key == EKeys::Enter);
		if (Key == EKeys::Enter || Key == EKeys::Escape)
		{
			return;
		}
	}

	if (Key == EKeys::W || Key == EKeys::Up)
	{
		Move(-1);
	}
	else if (Key == EKeys::S || Key == EKeys::Down)
	{
		Move(1);
	}

python -c "import PIL; print(PIL.__version__)"; LOGS=/d/UE/wt/ui1_farmlogs; S="C:/Users/USER/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/ce66ae306241b5fa/c0b1a6a8-6ed1-4de6-9c48-699082447a7f/scratchpad"; cat > "$S/tojpg.py" <<'EOF'
# tojpg.py <png dir> <out dir> <suffix>: every png -> jpg at most 960 wide
import sys, os
from PIL import Image
src, dst, suf = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
for n in sorted(os.listdir(src)):
    if not n.endswith('.png') or 'warmup' in n: continue
    im = Image.open(os.path.join(src, n)).convert('RGB')
    if im.width > 960:
        im = im.resize((960, round(im.height * 960 / im.width)), Image.LANCZOS)
    out = os.path.join(dst, n[:-4] + '_' + suf + '.jpg')
    im.save(out, quality=88)
    print(out)
EOF
python -I "$S/tojpg.py" $LOGS/shots0_1920 "$S/s0" 1080; python -I "$S/tojpg.py" $LOGS/shots0_1280 "$S/s0" 720

};\n\n\t\t// ---- CONTROLS\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tFSupercutSettingRow Row = SettingsSlider(ETab::Controls, TEXT(\"MOUSE\"), TEXT(\"SENSITIVITY\"),\n\t\t\t\tUSupercutUserSettings::SensitivityLowest, USupercutUserSettings::SensitivityHighest, USupercutUserSettings::SensitivityStep, 0.01f, 2, 1.f);\n\t\t\tRow.Get = [Settings] { return Settings().GetSensitivity(); };\n\t\t\tRow.Set = [Settings](float Value) { Settings().SetSensitivity(Value); };\n\t\t\tRows.Add(MoveTemp(Row));\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// ---- AUDIO\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tFSupercutSettingRow Row = SettingsSlider(ETab::Audio, TEXT(\"VOLUME\"), TEXT(\"MASTER\"), 0.f, 100.f, 5.f, 1.f, 0, 100.f);\n\t\t\tRow.Get = [Settings] { return float(Settings().GetVolume()); };\n\t\t\tRow.Set = [Settings](float Value) { Settings().SetVolume(FMath::RoundToInt(Value)); };\n\t\t\tRows.Add(MoveTemp(Row));\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// ---- VIDEO\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tFSupercutSettingRow Row = SettingsStepper(ETab::Video, TEXT(\"DISPLAY\"), TEXT(\"DISPLAY MODE\"), { TEXT(\"FULLSCREEN\"), TEXT(\"WINDOW\") }, 0);\n\t\t\tRow.bWindow = true;\n\t\t\tRow.bResets = false; };\n\t\t\tRows.Add(MoveTemp(Row));\n\t\t}\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tFSupercutSettingRow Row = SettingsStepper(ETab::Video, TEXT(\"QUALITY\"), TEXT(\"OVERALL\"), { TEXT(\"LOW\"), TEXT(\"MEDIUM\"), TEXT(\"HIGH\"), TEXT(\"EPIC\") }, 2);\n\t\t\t// Groups that are not all at one level read as HIGH, as the old QUALITY row did.\n\t\t\tRow.Get = [Settings] { const int32 Level = Settings().GetQuality(); return float(Level < 0 ? 2 : Level); };\n\t\t\tRow.Set = [Settings](float Value) { Settings().SetQuality(FMath::RoundToInt(Value)); };\n\t\t\tRows.Add(MoveTemp(Row));\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn Rows;\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Rows\n\nFString FSupercutSettingRow::Format(float Value) const\n{\n\tif (Control == EControl::Stepper)\n\t{\n\t\treturn Entries.IsValidIndex(FMath::RoundToInt(Value)) ? Entries[FMath::RoundToInt(Value)] : FString();\n\t}\n\treturn FString::Printf(TEXT(\"%.*f%s\"), Decimals, Value, *Suffix);\n}\n\nFString FSupercutSettingRow::Shown() const\n{\n\treturn Get ? Format(Get()) : FString();\n}\n\nconst TArray<FSupercutSettingRow>& FSupercutSettingsScreen::Rows()\n{\n\tstatic const TArray<FSupercutSettingRow> All = SettingsMakeRows();\n\treturn All;\n}\n\nconst TCHAR* FSupercutSettingsScreen::TabName(ESupercutTab Tab)\n{\n\tswitch (Tab)\n\t{\n\tcase ETab::Gameplay: return TEXT(\"GAMEPLAY\");\n\tcase ETab::Crosshair: return TEXT(\"CROSSHAIR\");\n\tcase ETab::Controls: return TEXT(\"CONTROLS\");\n\tcase ETab::Accessibility: return TEXT(\"ACCESSIBILITY\");\n\tcase ETab::Audio: return TEXT(\"AUDIO\");\n\tdefault: return TEXT(\"VIDEO\");\n\t}\n}\n\nTArray<int32> FSupercutSettingsScreen::TabRows(ESupercutTab InTab)\n{\n\tTArray<int32> Out;\n\tconst TArray<FSupercutSettingRow>& All = Rows();\n\tfor (int32 Index = 0; Index < All.Num(); ++Index)\n\t{\n\t\tif (All[Index].Tab == InTab)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tOut.Add(Index);\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn Out;\n}\n\nTArray<FSupercutSettingsScreen::FItem> FSupercutSettingsScreen::Items(ESupercutTab InTab)\n{\n\tTArray<FItem> Out;\n\tFString Section;\n\tfor (const int32 Row : TabRows(InTab))\n\t{\n\t\tconst FSupercutSettingRow& Def = Rows()[Row];\n\t\tif (Def.Section != Section)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tSection = Def.Section;\n\t\t\tOut.Add({ INDEX_NONE, Section });\n\t\t}\n\t\tOut.Add({ Row, FString() });\n\t}\n\treturn Out;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------- State\n\nFSupercutSettingsScreen::FSupercutSettingsScreen(TFunction<void(FName)> InCue)\n\t: Cue(MoveTemp(InCue))\n{\n}\n\nvoid FSupercutSettingsScreen::Open()\n{\n\tTyped.Reset();\n\tSetTab(ETab::Gameplay);\n}\n\nvoid FSupercutSettingsScreen::SetTab(ESupercutTab NewTab)\n{\n\tTyped.Reset();\n\tTab = NewTab;\n\tTop = 0;\n\tSelected = INDEX_NONE;\n\tfor (const int32 Row : TabRows(Tab))\n\t{\n\t\tif (Rows()[Row].IsEnabled())\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tSelected = Row;\n\t\t\tbreak;\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tMakeShown();\n}\n\nint32 FSupercutSettingsScreen::ShownItems(float H) const\n{\n\tconst FSupercutUiStyle& Style = FSupercutUiStyle::Get();\n\tconst TArray<FItem> All = Items(Tab);\n\tconst float Room = (0.92f - 0.10f) * H;\n\tfloat Used = 0.f;\n\tint32 Count = 0;\n\tfor (int32 Index = Top; Index < All.Num(); ++Index)\n\t{\n\t\tconst float Height = (All[Index].Row == INDEX_NONE ? Style.SectionH : Style.RowPitch) * H;\n\t\tif (Used + Height > Room + 0.5f)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tbreak;\n\t\t}\n\t\tUsed += Height;\n\t\t++Count;\n\t}\n\treturn Count;\n}\n\nvoid FSupercutSettingsScreen::MakeShown()\n{\n\tif (Selected == INDEX_NONE)\n\t{\n\t\treturn;\n\t}\n\tconst TArray<FItem> All = Items(Tab);\n\tconst int32 Item = All.IndexOfByPredicate([this](const FItem& It) { return It.Row == Selected; });\n\t// Keep the row's header in view with it when the row is the first of its section.\n\tconst int32 Wanted = Item > 0 && All[Item - 1].Row == INDEX_NONE ? Item - 1 : Item;\n\tif (Wanted < Top)\n\t{\n\t\tTop = Wanted;\n\t}\n\twhile (Item >= Top + ShownItems(LastH) && Top < Item)\n\t{\n\t\t++Top;\n\t}\n}\n\nvoid FSupercutSettingsScreen::Scroll(int32 Steps)\n{\n\tconst int32 Count = Items(Tab).Num();\n\tconst int32 Before = Top;\n\tfor (int32 Step = 0; Step < FMath::Abs(Steps); ++Step)\n\t{\n\t\tif (Steps > 0 && Top + ShownItems(LastH) < Count)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\t++Top;\n\t\t}\n\t\telse if (Steps < 0 && Top > 0)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\t--Top;\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif (Top != Before)\n\t{\n\t\tUE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT(\"MENU settings %s scrolled to item %d\"), TabName(Tab), Top);\n\t}\n}\n\nvoid FSupercutSettingsScreen::Move(int32 Step)\n{\n\tconst TArray<int32> TabList = TabRows(Tab);\n\tint32 At = TabList.Find(Selected);\n\tfor (int32 Next = At + Step; TabList.IsValidIndex(Next); Next += Step)\n\t{\n\t\tif (Rows()[TabList[Next]].IsEnabled())\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tSelected = TabList[Next];\n\t\t\tCue(TEXT(\"ui_move\"));\n\t\t\tMakeShown();\n\t\t\treturn;\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nbool FSupercutSettingsScreen::PressKey(const FKey& Key, bool bShift)\n{\n\tif (Type(Key))\n\t{\n\t\treturn true;\n\t}\n\tif (IsTyping())\n\t{\n\t\t// Enter sets the typed value and does no more. Any other key drops it and does its job.\n\t\tif (Key == EKeys::Enter)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tCue(TEXT(\"ui_pick\"));\n\t\t\tStopTyping(true);\n\t\t\treturn true;\n\t\t}\n\t\tStopTyping(false);\n\t}\n\tif (Key == EKeys::W || Key == EKeys::Up)\n\t{\n\t\tMove(-1);\n\t}\n\telse if (Key == EKeys::S || Key == EKeys::Down)\n\t{\n\t\tMove(1);\n\t}\n\telse if (Key == EKeys::Q || Key == EKeys::E)\n\t{\n\t\tconst int32 Count = int32(ETab::Count);\n\t\tconst int32 Next = int32(Tab) + (Key == EKeys::Q ? -1 : 1);\n\t\tif (Next >= 0 && Next < Count)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tCue(TEXT(\"ui_pick\"));\n\t\t\tSetTab(ETab(Next));\n\t\t\tUE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT(\"MENU settings tab %s\"), TabName(Tab));\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\telse if (Key == EKeys::A || Key == EKeys::Left || Key == EKeys::D || Key == EKeys::Right)\n\t{\n\t\tif (Selected != INDEX_NONE && Rows()[Selected].IsValue())\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tconst bool bLess = Key == EKeys::A || Key == EKeys::Left;\n\t\t\tif (Change(Selected, bLess ? -1 : 1, bShift, false))\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tCue(TEXT(\"ui_pick\"));   // the value moved one step\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\telse\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tCue(TEXT(\"ui_deny\"));   // at the end of its range\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\telse if (Key == EKeys::Enter || Key == EKeys::SpaceBar)\n\t{\n\t\tif (Selected != INDEX_NONE && Rows()[Selected].Control == EControl::Stepper)\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tCue(TEXT(\"ui_pick\"));\n\t\t\tChange(Selected, 1, false, true);\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\telse if (Key == EKeys::X)\n\t{\n\t\tCue(TEXT(\"ui_pick\"));\n\t\tResetTab();\n\t}\n\telse if (Key == EKeys::MouseScrollUp || Key == EKeys::MouseScrollDown)\n\t{\n\t\tScroll(Key == EKeys::MouseScrollUp ? -1 : 1);\n\t}\n\telse\n\t{\n\t\treturn false;\n\t}\n\treturn true;\n}\n\nvoid FSupercutSettingsScreen::PointAt(const FSupercutUiTarget& Target)\n{\n\tif (Target.Kind != ESupercutUiKind::Tab && Target.Kind != ESupercutUiKind::Hint && Rows().IsValidIndex(Target.Index)\n\t\t&& Rows()[Target.Index].IsEnabled() && Target.Index != Selected)\n\t{\n\t\tTyped.Reset();\n\t\tSelected = Target.Index;\n\t}\n}\n\nvoid FSupercutSettingsScreen::ClickOn(const FSupercutUiTarget& Target)\n{\n\tTyped.Reset();\n\tswitch (Target.Kind)\n\t{\n\tcase ESupercutUiKind::Tab:\n\t\tSetTab(ETab(Target.Index));\n\t\tUE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT(\"MENU settings tab %s\"), TabName(Tab));\n\t\treturn;\n\tcase ESupercutUiKind::Hint:\n\t\tif (Target.Index == int32(ESupercutUiHint::Reset))\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tResetTab();\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn;\n\tdefault:\n\t\tbreak;\n\t}\n\tif (!Rows().IsValidIndex(Target.Index) || !Rows()[Target.Index].IsEnabled())\n\t{\n\t\treturn;\n\t}\n\tSelected = Target.Index;\n\tconst FSupercutSettingRow& Row = Rows()[Selected];\n\tif (Target.Kind == ESupercutUiKind::Less || Target.Kind == ESupercutUiKind::More)\n\t{\n\t\tChange(Selected, Target.Kind == ESupercutUiKind::Less ? -1 : 1, false, false);\n\t}\n\telse if (Target.Kind == ESupercutUiKind::Row && Row.Control == EControl::Stepper)\n\t{\n\t\tChange(Selected, 1, false, true);\n\t}\n}\n\nvoid FSupercutSettingsScreen::ResetTab()\n{\n\tTyped.Reset();\n\tfor (const int32 Row : TabRows(Tab))\n\t{\n\t\tconst FSupercutSettingRow& Def = Rows()[Row];\n\t\tif (Def.bResets && Def.IsValue())\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tCommit(Row, Def.Default);\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tUE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT(\"MENU settings %s reset to defaults\"), TabName(Tab));\n}\n\nbool FSupercutSettingsScreen::Change(int32 Row, int32 Steps, bool bFine, bool bRound)\n{\n\tconst FSupercutSettingRow& Def = Rows()[Row];\n\tconst float Now = Def.Get();\n\tfloat Next = Now;\n\tif (Def.Control == EControl::Stepper)\n\t{\n\t\tconst int32 Count = Def.Entries.Num();\n\t\tconst int32 Index = FMath::RoundToInt(Now) + Steps;\n\t\tNext = float(bRound ? (Index % Count + Count) % Count : FMath::Clamp(Index, 0, Count - 1));\n\t}\n\telse\n\t{\n\t\t// To the next point on the step's grid, so 0.86 and a step down of 0.05 gives 0.85.\n\t\tconst float Step = bFine ? Def.Fine : Def.Step;\n\t\tconst float OnGrid = Now / Step;\n\t\tconst float Points = Steps > 0 ? FMath::FloorToFloat(OnGrid + 0.01f) + Steps : FMath::CeilToFloat(OnGrid - 0.01f) + Steps;\n\t\tNext = FMath::Clamp(Points * Step, Def.Lowest, Def.Highest);\n\t}\n\treturn Commit(Row, Next);\n}\n\nbool FSupercutSettingsScreen::Commit(int32 Row, float Value)\n{\n\tconst FSupercutSettingRow& Def = Rows()[Row];\n\tconst FString Before = Def.Shown();\n\tDef.Set(Value);\n\tconst FString After = Def.Shown();\n\tif (After == Before)\n\t{\n\t\treturn false;\n\t}\n\tUSupercutUserSettings::Get().ApplyAndSave(Def.bWindow);\n\tUE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT(\"MENU set %s %s to %s\"), *Def.Label, *Before, *After);\n\treturn true;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Typing on a slider\n\nbool FSupercutSettingsScreen::Type(const FKey& Key)\n{\n\tif (Selected == INDEX_NONE || !Rows()[Selected].IsSlider())\n\t{\n\t\treturn false;\n\t}\n\tconst FSupercutSettingRow& Def = Rows()[Selected];\n\tstatic const FKey Digits[] = { EKeys::Zero, EKeys::One, EKeys::Two, EKeys::Three, EKeys::Four, EKeys::Five, EKeys::Six, EKeys::Seven, EKeys::Eight, EKeys::Nine };\n\tstatic const FKey PadDigits[] = { EKeys::NumPadZero, EKeys::NumPadOne, EKeys::NumPadTwo, EKeys::NumPadThree, EKeys::NumPadFour,\n\t\tEKeys::NumPadFive, EKeys::NumPadSix, EKeys::NumPadSeven, EKeys::NumPadEight, EKeys::NumPadNine };\n\tif (Key == EKeys::BackSpace)\n\t{\n\t\tif (!IsTyping())\n\t\t{\n\t\t\treturn false;\n\t\t}\n\t\tTyped.LeftChopInline(1);   // the last character off; with none left the typing is over and nothing changed\n\t\tCue(TEXT(\"ui_move\"));\n\t\treturn true;\n\t}\n\tTCHAR Char = 0;\n\tfor (int32 Digit = 0; Digit < 10; ++Digit)\n\t{\n\t\tif (Key == Digits[Digit] || Key == PadDigits[Digit])\n\t\t{\n\t\t\tChar = TCHAR('0' + Digit);\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif ((Key == EKeys::Period || Key == EKeys::Decimal) && Def.Decimals > 0)\n\t{\n\t\tChar = TEXT('.');\n\t}\n\tif (Char == 0)\n\t{\n\t\treturn false;\n\t}\n\tconst int32 Longest = Def.Format(Def.Highest).Len() - Def.Suffix.Len();   // \"3.00\", \"100\", \"255\"\n\tint32 Point = INDEX_NONE;\n\tif (Typed.Len() < Longest && !(Char == TEXT('.') && Typed.FindChar(TEXT('.'), Point)))\n\t{\n\t\tTyped.AppendChar(Char);\n\t}\n\tCue(TEXT(\"ui_move\"));\n\treturn true;\n}\n\nvoid FSupercutSettingsScreen::StopTyping(bool bApply)\n{\n\tconst FString Text = Typed;\n\tTyped.Reset();\n\tconst FSupercutSettingRow& Def = Rows()[Selected];\n\tif (!bApply)\n\t{\n\t\tUE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT(\"MENU typed %s \\\"%s\\\" dropped\"), *Def.Label, *Text);\n\t\treturn;\n\t}\n\tUE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT(\"MENU typed %s \\\"%s\\\"\"), *Def.Label, *Text);\n\tCommit(Selected, FMath::Clamp(FCString::Atof(*Text), Def.Lowest, Def.Highest));\n}\n\nbool FSupercutSettingsScreen::DropTyping()\n{\n\tif (!IsTyping())\n\t{\n\t\treturn false;\n\t}\n\tStopTyping(false);\n\treturn true;\n}\n"

## 11. Build order

Today's interface is immediate-mode canvas drawing in `ASupercutHUD::DrawHUD` (rectangles, lines, `FCanvasTextItem`
with the engine's Roboto), with menu state in `USupercutMenu` and hit-testing on the same rectangles as the drawing.

**Can it carry the motion?** Yes, for everything in this spec. Every animation here is alpha, a flat offset or a
small scale computed from a timer each frame, which the HUD already does (letterbox easing, stamp pop, refused-clap
shake). Needs: (1) a real-time clock per layer (opened-at time in `GetRealTimeSeconds`, since the world is paused
under menus; `RenderDelta` works too); (2) a helper that draws the screen reveal for a rectangle given its start
frame; (3) the glow, as a soft-edged 9-slice texture drawn around the rectangle (or three rectangles at 30, 18 and
8 % alpha); (4) the hatch and sheen, as two small textures clipped to the primary block. What the canvas cannot do
cheaply: background blur and custom fonts without an imported `UFont` asset. The spec uses a flat wash instead of
blur. Roboto Bold is a clear face and carries both directions' layouts. Moving to UMG is not needed.

The commentary roughly doubles the settings work, so this is no longer one day for one agent: about 14 h of agent
time. After a shared first step it splits into two lanes that touch different code (menus against HUD and cards),
about 8 h and 6 h.

| Step | Lane | What | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | shared | Style struct: colour roles, type sizes, row/key-cap/primary-block helpers, glow, hatch and sheen, reveal helper; one hover-sound hook in the hit-testing so every element entered plays `ui_move` and every click `ui_pick` | 1 h |
| A1 | menus | Settings frame: six tabs, rows box with section headers, scroll by row, scrollbar, key hints, `X` reset, Esc back to where it came from | 1 h 30 |
| A2 | menus | Row controls: stepper chips, slider with centred number and caret outside it, Shift steps, drag, typing; DISPLAY reads the open window (after confirming the cause) | 45 min |
| A3 | menus | GAMEPLAY, ACCESSIBILITY, AUDIO, VIDEO rows wired to the engine (sound classes, scalability, frame rate, VSync, FOV, motion blur, TSR render resolution, overlay); check each engine name against 5.9 first | 2 h |
| A4 | menus | CROSSHAIR tab, preview squares, HUD crosshair drawn from the settings | 1 h |
| A5 | menus | Key rebinding with swap, through Enhanced Input | 1 h 15 |
| A6 | menus | Title: backdrop under the wash, wordmark, STA

    s = s.replace(old, new)

FString USupercutMenu::RowLabel(ESupercutRow Row, ESupercutScreen OnScreen)
{

	case ERow::Start: return TEXT("START");
	case ERow::Resume: return TEXT("RESUME");

#!/bin/bash
# waits until [pc-c] passes FARM.md's load check; prints the passing status
F="[notes]/unreal/megajam-2026/farm/farm.sh"
for i in $(seq 1 90); do
  out=$("$F" status [pc-c] 2>&1)
  cpu=$(echo "$out" | sed -n 's/^cpu_load_pct=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
  ram=$(echo "$out" | sed -n 's/^free_ram_gb=\([0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | cut -d. -f1)
  busy=$(echo "$out" | grep '^busy_procs=')
  if ! echo "$busy" | grep -q Supercut && ! echo "$busy" | grep -q UnrealEditor && [ "${cpu:-100}" -lt 60 ] && [ "${ram:-0}" -ge 6 ]; then
    date +%H:%M; echo "$out"; exit 0
  fi
  echo "$(date +%H:%M) wait cpu=$cpu ram=$ram $busy"
  sleep 60
done
exit 1
EOF
chmod +x "$S/waitfarm.sh"; date +%H:%M

### One interaction model for every screen
From the reference, applied to SUPERCUT **[ref 1, 5, 11]**:
1. **Most changes snap.** Hover, selection, tab change, scroll and value change are 0 ms. Only a layer arriving or
   leaving (a screen, a panel, a modal, a card) animates, and never for more than 367 ms.
2. **Selected = inverted.** The selected row or tab is a solid `Chalk` fill with `Ink` text. Hover without selection
   is an outline plus a glow on everything that can be clicked **[owner 0:44]**: `Chalk` outline 0.003 H inside the
   edge, and a soft glow outside it falling from 45 % to 0 over 0.007 H **[ref 1: 4-5 px and about 10 px at 1440p]**.
   A hovered tab also gets a `Chalk` 14 % block behind it **[ref 1]**. Nothing else marks state.
3. **One loud thing per screen.** One primary block per screen, the biggest text after the title, bottom right on
   the title screen, top of the panel on pause.
4. **A key-hint row on every menu screen** at y 0.955 H from x 0.054 W, Esc first.
5. **Esc closes the top layer only**: modal, then panel, then screen. Esc never quits **[now]**.
6. **Square corners everywhere** **[owner 0:00]**: no radius on any panel, row, chip, key cap, card or button.
7. **Clear type only** **[owner 0:11]**: a clean condensed sans for labels and a plain face for values. No
   hand-lettered or script face anywhere; direction B keeps its stencil face for the wordmark and big numbers only.
8. **Every hover and every click makes a sound** **[owner 0:18-0:44]** (Sounds, below).
9. **Important things carry a texture and a sheen that cycles** **[owner 1:08]**: the primary block on each screen,
   and any new item. Primary block, below.

### Shared pieces
These are drawn the same everywhere; build them once.

**Key cap** **[ref 11]**: box 0.024 H tall, width = text width + 0.012 H, `Chalk` fill, `Ink` text cap 0.012 H,
centred. Hint = key cap, 0.008 W gap, verb in `Chalk` 85 %, cap 0.014 H. Hints 0.028 W apart.

bool FTestWorldWrapper::DestroyTestWorld(bool bForceGarbageCollect)
{
	if (TestWorld == nullptr)
	{
		ReportFailure(TEXT("TestWorld does not exist in DestroyTestWorld!"));
		return false;
	}

	// End play if it hasn't already happened, this will do nothing if it didn't spawn a game mode

	if (TestWorld->GetGameInstance() != nullptr)
	{

	}

	GEngine->DestroyWorldContext(TestWorld);
	TestWorld->DestroyWorld(false);
	TestWorld = nullptr;

	if (bForceGarbageCollect)

		CollectGarbage(GARBAGE_COLLECTION_KEEPFLAGS);

		// Verify it was actually destroyed
		GEngine->CheckAndHandleStaleWorldObjectReferences();
	}

	return true;
}

struct FUiSettingsKeeper
	{
		FUiSettingsKeeper()
		{
			USupercutUserSettings& Settings = USupercutUserSettings::Get();
			Kept = DuplicateObject(&Settings, GetTransientPackage());
			Kept->AddToRoot();   // held outside any UObject, so garbage collection would not see it
		}
		~FUiSettingsKeeper()
		{
			USupercutUserSettings& Settings = USupercutUserSettings::Get();
			for (TFieldIterator<FProperty> It(USupercutUserSettings::StaticClass()); It; ++It)
			{
				if (It->HasAnyPropertyFlags(CPF_Config))
				{
					It->CopyCompleteValue_InContainer(&Settings, Kept);
				}
			}
			Settings.SaveSettings();
			Kept->RemoveFromRoot();
		}

	TOptional<float> MenuTrackFraction(const USupercutMenu& Menu, float Width, float Height, const FSupercutUiTarget& Track, float X)
	{
		TArray<FSupercutUiElement> Elements;
		SupercutMenuView::Layout(Menu, Width, Height, Elements);
		const FSupercutUiElement* Found = Elements.FindByPredicate([&Track](const FSupercutUiElement& Element) { return Element.Target == Track; });
		if (!Found)
		{
			return {};
		}
		return FMath::Clamp(float((X - Found->Box.Min.X) / Found->Box.GetSize().X), 0.f, 1.f);
	}

Build anything that goes to the judges on c4.
- The first build of a new name is a full compile ([pc-b]: 41 files, 69 s at 8 jobs). Later builds are incremental.
- `run_demo.ps1` stops the game at 240 s unless you pass `-TimeoutSeconds`, and then exits 3. main8 took 118 s on
  [pc-b], 179 s on [pc-c] and 472 s on pc2 (its GTX 1070 draws about 70 frames a second, and a fixed-step run draws
  every one of the 23,500 steps). On pc2 always pass `-TimeoutSeconds 900`.

## Two lanes on one PC

- Each lane uses its own name: its own mirror, packages and logs. Two names never share files.
- **Builds queue.** UBT holds one mutex per engine copy (`UnrealBuildTool.cs`, keyed on UBT's own path) and the
  Tools scripts pass `-waitmutex`, so a second lane's build or package compile waits for the first to finish. So
  ask for the jobs as if alone: on [pc-b] (16 threads) `-Jobs 8`, leaving half the PC to its user. `package` and
  `package-shipping` compile at one job (`-MaxParallelActions=1` in the scripts); that is the scripts' choice.
- Tests and cooks do not take that mutex and can run beside another lane's step.

# SUPERCUT interface spec (lane uiref1, 14 Nov 2026)

Build-ready layout, states, motion and sound for every SUPERCUT screen. Desktop, mouse and keyboard, 16:9 from
1280x720 to 2560x1440. The reference video gave layout, hierarchy, density, motion and feedback; nothing of its look
is used. Its notes are in `REFERENCE.md`.

Tags: **[ref]** a number measured from the reference (section of `REFERENCE.md` in brackets). **[pick]** my choice.
**[taste: owner review]** a look decision the owner locks. **[now]** what the game does today (code read 14 Nov).
**[owner]** the owner's spoken commentary on the recording asks for it (time in brackets; section 12 lists every
statement and where this spec answers it). His words outrank the measurements.

Correction pass, 14 Nov evening: the first version was written without the commentary. It changed square corners,
type, hover glow, the sheen, the background, the pause panel (now from the left, no CONTROLS), the settings (six tabs
with the reference's amount of settings, full crosshair customisation, key bindings), a new loading card (section 9),
a skins layout (section 10), the build order (section 11) and the sounds.

## 0. Ground rules

### Units
- Positions and sizes are fractions of screen width **W** or height **H**. Everything scales with H, as the HUD does
  today (`S = H / 720`). At 16:9, 1 W = 1.778 H.
- Text size is given as **cap height / H**. For the canvas `Label` call: font size in pixels is about
  `cap / 0.71 * H` for Roboto Bold (the engine's medium font) **[pick: measure once in game and correct the 0.71]**.
  Example: cap 0.020 H at 1440p is 28.8 px of cap, size 40.
- Frames are at 60 fps: 1 f = 16.7 ms. Times in the spec are in ms, frames in brackets when measured.
- Easing names: **out** = cubic ease-out `1-(1-t)^3`; **in** = `t^3`; **inout** = smoothstep `t*t*(3-2t)`;
  **snap** = 0 ms.

### Colour roles
SUPERCUT spends four hues on world signals (GAME.md): red-orange **danger**, green **the way on**, yellow **the
player's shots**, cyan **frozen time**. The interface uses them only to carry that same meaning, never as chrome.

| Role | Used for | Value |
|---|---|---|
| `Ink` | panel fill | per direction, achromatic **[taste: owner review]** |
| `Chalk` | main text, outlines, selected fill | per direction, achromatic |
| `Dim` | secondary text, empty pips, disabled | `Chalk` at 45 % **[ref 5, disabled contrast]** |
| `Line` | separators, idle outlines | `Chalk` at 25 % |
| `Wash` | dim behind menus

**Can it carry the motion?** Yes, for everything in this spec. Every animation here is alpha, a flat offset or a
small scale computed from a timer each frame, which the HUD already does (letterbox easing, stamp pop, refused-clap
shake). Needs: (1) a real-time clock per layer (opened-at time in `GetRealTimeSeconds`, since the world is paused
under menus; `RenderDelta` works too); (2) a helper that draws the screen reveal for a rectangle given its start
frame; (3) the glow, as a soft-edged 9-slice texture drawn around the rectangle (or three rectangles at 30, 18 and
8 % alpha); (4) the hatch and sheen, as two small textures clipped to the primary block. What the canvas cannot do
cheaply: background blur and custom fonts without an imported `UFont` asset. The spec uses a flat wash instead of
blur. Roboto Bold is a clear face and carries both directions' layouts. Moving to UMG is not needed.

#include "SupercutMenuView.h"
#include "SupercutMenu.h"
#include "Supercut.h"
#include "SupercutSettingsScreen.h"

namespace
{
	using ERow = ESupercutRow;

	/** Today's centred rows (step 0): the title from 0.52 H, the pause screen from 0.36 H. */
	FBox2D ViewRowBox(ESupercutScreen Screen, int32 Index, float W, float H)
	{
		const FSupercutUiStyle& Style = FSupercutUiStyle::Get();
		const float S = H / 720.f;
		const float RowW = 400.f * S;
		const float Top = H * (Screen == ESupercutScreen::Title ? 0.52f : 0.36f);
		const FVector2D Corner(W * 0.5f - RowW * 0.5f, Top + Index * Style.RowPitch * H);
		return FBox2D(Corner, Corner + FVector2D(RowW, Style.RowH * H));
	}

	/** The control column of a settings row. */
	FBox2D ViewControl(const FBox2D& Row, float W)
	{
		const FSupercutUiStyle& Style = FSupercutUiStyle::Get();
		return FBox2D(FVector2D(Style.ControlLeftW * W, Row.Min.Y), FVector2D(Style.ControlRightW * W, Row.Max.Y));
	}

	/** A settings row's two arrow chips, at the ends of its control column. */
	FBox2D ViewChip(const FBox2D& Row, bool bLess, float W, float H)
	{
		const FSupercutUiStyle& Style = FSupercutUiStyle::Get();
		const FBox2D Control = ViewControl(Row, W);
		const float Size = Style.ChipH * H;
		const float Inset = Style.ChipInsetH * H;
		const float Top = Row.GetCenter().Y - Size * 0.5f;
		const float Left = bLess ? Control.Min.X + Inset : Control.Max.X - Inset - Size;
		return FBox2D(FVector2D(Left, Top), FVector2D(Left + Size, Top + Size));
	}

	/** A slider's track: the control column less TrackInsetH each side, TrackH tall, on the row's centre. */
	FBox2D ViewTrack(const FBox2D& Row, float W, float H)
	{
		const FSupercutUiStyle& Style = FSupercutUiStyle::Get();
		const FBox2D Control = ViewControl(Row, W);
		const float Inset = Style.TrackInsetH * H;
		const float Half = Style.TrackH * H * 0.5f;
		return FBox2D(FVector2D(Control.Min.X + Inset, Row.GetCenter().Y - Half), FVector2D(Control.Max.X - Inset, Row.GetCenter().Y + Half));
	}

```
void USupercutMenu::ClickOn(const FSupercutUiTarget& Target)
{
	if (!IsOpen() || !Target.IsSet())
	{
		return;
	}
	PlayCue(TEXT("ui_pick"));
	PressedAt = RealNow();
	if (Target.Kind == ESupercutUiKind::Hint && Target.Index == int32(ESupercutUiHint::Back))
	{
		SettingsScreen->DropTyping();
		Back();
		return;
	}
	if (Screen == ESupercutScreen::Settings)
	{
		SettingsScreen->ClickOn(Target);
		return;
	}
	check(GetRows().IsValidIndex(Target.Index));
	Selected = Target.Index;
	Choose();
}

void USupercutMenu::DragOn(const FSupercutUiTarget& Target, float Fraction, bool bStart)
{
	checkf(Screen == ESupercutScreen::Settings && Target.Kind == ESupercutUiKind::Track, TEXT("USupercutMenu::DragOn: %s is not a slider's track on the settings screen"), *Target.Describe());
	SettingsScreen->DragTo(Target.Index, Fraction, bStart);
}

void USupercutMenu::Move(int32 Step)
{
	const int32 Count = GetRows().Num();
	const int32 Next = (Selected + Step + Count) % Count;
	if (Next != Selected)
	{
		Selected = Next;
		PlayCue(TEXT("ui_move"));
	}
}

void USupercutMenu::Back()
{
	switch (Screen)
	{
	case ESupercutScreen::Pause:
		Resume();
		break;
	case ESupercutScreen::Settings:
		Open(Under, UnderSelected);
		break;
	default:
		break;   // the title screen has nothing to go back to
	}
}

void USupercutMenu::Resume()
{
	if (bPausedWorld)
	{
		MenuSetWorldPaused(this, false);
	}
	bPausedWorld = false;
	Open(ESupercutScreen::None, 0);
}

void USupercutMenu::Choose()
{
	const ESupercutRow Row = GetRows()[Selected];
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("MENU chose %s"), *RowLabel(Row, Screen));
	USupercutRun& Run = USupercutRun::Get(this);
	switch (Row)
	{
	case ERow::Start:
		Open(ESupercutScreen::None, 0);
		Run.StartFromTitle();
		break;
	case ERow::Resume:
		Resume();
		break;
	case ERow::RestartRun:
		bPausedWorld = false;   // the run lets the world roll
		Open(ESupercutScreen::None, 0);
		Run.RestartRun();
		break;
	case ERow::Settings:
		Under = Screen;
		UnderSelected = Selected;
		Open(ESupercutScreen::Settings, 0);
		SettingsScreen->Open();
		break;
	case ERow::QuitToTitle:
		bPausedWorld = false;   // the title keeps the world paused until START
		Run.ShowTitle();
		Open(ESupercutScreen::Title, 0);
		break;
	case ERow::QuitGame:
		bQuitRequested = true;
		break;
	}
}

bool FSupercutShellTitleTest::RunTest(const FString& Parameters)
{
	TestTrue(TEXT("a plain start shows the title"), USupercutRun::StartsAtTitle(TEXT("")));
	TestTrue(TEXT("a seed alone shows the title"), USupercutRun::StartsAtTitle(TEXT("-SupercutSeed=4 -windowed")));
	TestFalse(TEXT("-SupercutRun= skips the title"), USupercutRun::StartsAtTitle(TEXT("-SupercutRun=main8 -SupercutSeed=1")));
	TestFalse(TEXT("-SupercutRoom= skips the title"), USupercutRun::StartsAtTitle(TEXT("-SupercutRoom=tests/plain")));
	TestFalse(TEXT("-SupercutScript= skips the title"), USupercutRun::StartsAtTitle(TEXT("-SupercutScript=D:/a/b.txt -SupercutQuit")));
	TestTrue(TEXT("-SupercutTitle asks for the title with a script"), USupercutRun::StartsAtTitle(TEXT("-SupercutScript=D:/a/b.txt -SupercutTitle")));

	FShellTestWorld World;
	if (!TestTrue(TEXT("test world starts"), World.Start()))
	{
		return false;
	}
	USupercutRun& Run = World.Run();
	Run.Begin({ ShellPlainRoom, ShellPlainRoom }, 1, true);
	TestTrue(TEXT("the run waits at its title"), Run.GetPhase() == ESupercutRunPhase::Title);
	TestEqual(TEXT("the title is no room entry"), Run.GetRoomEntries(), 0);
	TestNotNull(TEXT("the first room stands behind the title"), Run.GetRoom());
	TestNotNull(TEXT("the camera's character stands in it"), Run.GetHero());
	World.Menu().ShowTitle();
	TestTrue(TEXT("the title screen is up"), World.Menu().GetScreen() == ESupercutScreen::Title);
	TestTrue(TEXT("the world is paused at the title"), World.Paused());
	World.Tick(0.5f);
	TestTrue(TEXT("the run stays at its title"), Run.GetPhase() == ESupercutRunPhase::Title);

	World.ChooseRow(*this, ESupercutRow::Start);
	TestTrue(TEXT("START: playing scene 1 take 1"), Run.GetPhase() == ESupercutRunPhase::Playing && Run.GetScene() == 1 && Run.GetTake() == 1);
	TestEqual(TEXT("START: the first room entry"), Run.GetRoomEntries(), 1);
	TestFalse(TEXT("START: the world rolls"), World.Paused());
	TestEqual(TEXT("START: a full board"), World.Time().GetCharges(), World.Time().GetMaxCharges());
	return true;
}

private:

{
	const TSharedPtr<FSlateFontMeasure> Measure = FEngineFontServices::Get().GetFontMeasure();

	const FSlateFontInfo Font(GEngine->GetMediumFont(), FMath::RoundToInt(FontSize(Cap)), FName("Bold"));
	return float(FVector2D(Measure->Measure(String, Font)).X);

	Item.bCentreY = true;

bool FSupercutSettingsScreen::Change(int32 Row, int32 Steps, bool bFine, bool bRound)
{
	const FSupercutSettingRow& Def = Rows()[Row];
	const float Now = Def.Get();
	float Next = Now;
	if (Def.Control == EControl::Stepper)
	{
		const int32 Count = Def.Entries.Num();
		const int32 Index = FMath::RoundToInt(Now) + Steps;
		Next = float(bRound ? (Index % Count + Count) % Count : FMath::Clamp(Index, 0, Count - 1));
	}
	else
	{
		// To the next point on the step's grid, so 0.86 and a step down of 0.05 gives 0.85.
		const float Step = bFine ? Def.Fine : Def.Step;
		const float OnGrid = Now / Step;
		const float Points = Steps > 0 ? FMath::FloorToFloat(OnGrid + 0.01f) + Steps : FMath::CeilToFloat(OnGrid - 0.01f) + Steps;
		Next = FMath::Clamp(Points * Step, Def.Lowest, Def.Highest);
	}

	{

	/** The title, the pause, every settings tab from the title, and the CONTROLS tab from the pause. */
	TArray<FUiTestPlace> UiTestPlaces()
	{
		TArray<FUiTestPlace> Places = { { EUiTestScreen::Title }, { EUiTestScreen::Pause } };
		for (int32 Tab = 0; Tab < int32(ESupercutTab::Count); ++Tab)
		{
			Places.Add({ EUiTestScreen::SettingsFromTitle, ESupercutTab(Tab) });
		}
		Places.Add({ EUiTestScreen::SettingsFromPause, ESupercutTab::Controls });
		return Places;
	}

	FString UiTestPlaceName(const FUiTestPlace& Place)
	{
		switch (Place.Screen)
		{
		case EUiTestScreen::Title: return TEXT("title");
		case EUiTestScreen::Pause: return TEXT("pause");
		case EUiTestScreen::SettingsFromTitle: return FString::Printf(TEXT("settings %s from the title"), FSupercutSettingsScreen::TabName(Place.Tab));

	}

	/** Opens the place in World: the title, the pause over a room, or a settings tab from either. */

	{
		const EUiTestScreen Screen = Place.Screen;

		const bool bTitle = Screen == EUiTestScreen::Title || Screen == EUiTestScreen::SettingsFromTitle;
		World.Run().Begin({ UiPlainRoom, UiPlainRoom }, 1, bTitle);
		if (bTitle)
		{
			Menu.ShowTitle();
		}
		else

			World.Tick(0.1f);
			Menu.PressKey(EKeys::Escape);
		}
		if (Screen == EUiTestScreen::SettingsFromTitle || Screen == EUiTestScreen::SettingsFromPause)

				return false;
			}
			Menu.ClickOn({ ESupercutUiKind::Row, Row });
			Menu.GetSettings().SetTab(Place.Tab);
		}
		return true;
	}

namespace
{
	// A "scene" line that has waited this long for the next room fails the script.
	const float SceneWaitLimit = 20.f;

	/** How far along a slider's track X is, 0 at its left end and 1 at its right; unset when the track is not laid out (scrolled away). */
	TOptional<float> MenuTrackFraction(const USupercutMenu& Menu, float Width, float Height, const FSupercutUiTarget& Track, float X)
	{
		TArray<FSupercutUiElement> Elements;
		SupercutMenuView::Layout(Menu, Width, Height, Elements);
		const FSupercutUiElement* Found = Elements.FindByPredicate([&Track](const FSupercutUiElement& Element) { return Element.Target == Track; });
		if (!Found)
		{
			return {};
		}
		return FMath::Clamp(float((X - Found->Box.Min.X) / Found->Box.GetSize().X), 0.f, 1.f);
	}
}

ASupercutPlayerController::ASupercutPlayerController()
	void ViewSettingsLayout(const USupercutMenu& Menu, float W, float H, TArray<FSupercutUiElement>& Out)
	{
		const TArray<FBox2D> Tabs = ViewTabBoxes(W, H);
		for (int32 Tab = 0; Tab < Tabs.Num(); ++Tab)
		{
			Out.Add({ Tabs[Tab], { ESupercutUiKind::Tab, Tab } });
		}
		for (const FViewItem& Shown : ViewSettingsItems(Menu.GetSettings(), W, H))
		{
			const int32 Row = Shown.Item.Row;
			if (Row == INDEX_NONE || !FSupercutSettingsScreen::Rows()[Row].IsEnabled())
			{
				continue;   // a header or a disabled row takes no pointer
			}
			Out.Add({ Shown.Box, { ESupercutUiKind::Row, Row } });
			if (FSupercutSettingsScreen::Rows()[Row].IsSlider())
			{
				Out.Add({ ViewTrack(Shown.Box, W, H), { ESupercutUiKind::Track, Row } });
			}
			else if (FSupercutSettingsScreen::Rows()[Row].IsValue())
			{
				Out.Add({ ViewChip(Shown.Box, true, W, H), { ESupercutUiKind::Less, Row } });
				Out.Add({ ViewChip(Shown.Box, false, W, H), { ESupercutUiKind::More, Row } });
			}
		}
	}

# usage: pipe.sh <tag> [from-step]   steps: build test package main8 shots
# Runs lane ui1's checks on [pc-c] with FARM.md's load check before each heavy step. Logs per step under /d/UE/wt/ui1_farmlogs/<tag>.
S="C:/Users/USER/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/ce66ae306241b5fa/c0b1a6a8-6ed1-4de6-9c48-699082447a7f/scratchpad"
F="[notes]/unreal/megajam-2026/farm/farm.sh"
TAG=$1; FROM=${2:-build}
L=/d/UE/wt/ui1_farmlogs/$TAG; mkdir -p "$L"
EXE='{B}\Supercut59\Windows\Supercut.exe'
INI='F:\UE\Farm\_builds\ui1\Supercut59\Windows\Supercut\Saved\Config\Windows\GameUserSettings.ini'
wait_ok() { bash "$S/waitfarm.sh" | tail -1 | sed 's/^/  load ok /' || { echo "load check never passed"; exit 1; }; }
go=0
step() { [ "$1" = "$FROM" ] && go=1; [ $go = 1 ]; }
if step build; then
  # The mirror keeps c4's file times: a file edited before [pc-c]'s last build would look older than its object file.
  ( cd /d/UE/wt/ui1 && git diff --name-only HEAD -- Source | xargs -r touch )
  wait_ok; "$F" mirror [pc-c] ui1 /d/UE/wt/ui1 | tail -1
  "$F" build [pc-c] ui1 "$L/b" -Jobs 6 | tail -1
  grep -q "exit=0" "$L/b/build/farm_step.txt" 2>/dev/null || { grep -E "error" "$L/b/build/ubt_SupercutEditor.log" | head; echo "BUILD FAILED"; exit 1; }
fi
if step test; then
  wait_ok; "$F" test [pc-c] ui1 "$L/t" | tail -2
  grep -E "Result=\{Fail" "$L/t/test/tests.log" | cut -c1-200 | head
fi
if step package; then
  for try in $(seq 1 40); do
    wait_ok; "$F" package [pc-c] ui1 "$L/p" | tail -1
    grep -q "conflicting instance of AutomationTool" "$L/p/package/package_run.log" || break
    echo "  another lane's AutomationTool is running: retry in 60 s"; sleep 60
  done
  grep -q "exit=0" "$L/p/package/farm_step.txt" || { echo "PACKAGE FAILED"; exit 1; }
```

// The band is skewed: points of equal light lie on lines leaning SheenSkewDegrees from upright.
	// S = x + (centre y - y) * tan(skew) is the coordinate across the band; light falls linearly from the centre line.
	const float Tan = FMath::Tan(FMath::DegreesToRadians(Style.SheenSkewDegrees));
	const FVector2D Normal = FVector2D(1.f, -Tan).GetSafeNormal();
	const float Scale = FVector2D(1.f, -Tan).Size();
	const float CentreY = Box.GetCenter().Y;
	auto Across = [&](const FVector2D& P) { return P.X - (P.Y - CentreY) * Tan; };
	const float Centre = Box.Min.X + Phase * BlockW;
	const TArray<FVector2D> Rect = { Box.Min, FVector2D(Box.Max.X, Box.Min.Y), Box.Max, FVector2D(Box.Min.X, Box.Max.Y) };
	for (int32 Side = 0; Side < 2; ++Side)
	{
		const float From = Side == 0 ? Centre - HalfW : Centre;
		const float To = Side == 0 ? Centre : Centre + HalfW;
		// Dot(P, Normal) = Across(P) / Scale plus a constant from the centre line.
		const float Offset = CentreY * Tan / Scale;
		TArray<FVector2D> Part = UiClipPolygon(Rect, Normal, From / Scale - Offset);
		Part = UiClipPolygon(Part, -Normal, -(To / Scale - Offset));
		if (Part.Num() < 3)
		{
			continue;
		}
		TArray<FLinearColor> Colors;
		for (const FVector2D& Point : Part)
		{
			const float Light = FMath::Clamp(1.f - FMath::Abs(Across(Point) - Centre) / HalfW, 0.f, 1.f);
			Colors.Add(FLinearColor(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, Style.SheenAlpha * Light));
		}
		Polygon(Part, Colors);
	}
}

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "InputCoreTypes.h"
#include "SupercutUiStyle.h"

/** The settings screen's six tabs (UI_SPEC section 3). */
enum class ESupercutTab : uint8
{
	Gameplay,
	Crosshair,
	Controls,
	Accessibility,
	Audio,
	Video,
	Count
};

/** How a settings row is changed. */
enum class ESupercutControl : uint8
{
	Stepper,   // one entry of a list, two arrow chips
	Slider,    // a number on a track
	Action,    // a button (RESET)
	Keys,      // two key boxes
	Fixed,     // shown, never changed (PAUSE: Esc)
};

/** One row of the settings screen. Values are floats in the row's own units; a stepper's value is its entry's index. */
struct FSupercutSettingRow
{
	ESupercutTab Tab = ESupercutTab::Gameplay;
	FString Section;          // the header shown above the first row of each section
	FString Label;
	ESupercutControl Control = ESupercutControl::Stepper;
	float Lowest = 0.f;
	float Highest = 1.f;
	float Step = 1.f;         // the arrows and a click on a chip
	float Fine = 1.f;         // Shift and the arrows; dragging keeps to this too
	int32 Decimals = 0;
	FString Suffix;           // "%" on a percentage
	TArray<FString> Entries;  // a stepper's entries
	bool bWindow = false;     // applying it changes the window (DISPLAY)
	bool bResets = true;      // X puts it back to Default
	float Default = 0.f;
	TFunction<float()> Get;
	TFunction<void(float)> Set;      // keeps the value in range; the screen saves after it
	TFunction<bool()> Enabled;       // unset: always

	bool IsEnabled() const { return Control != ESupercutControl::Fixed && (!Enabled || Enabled()); }
	bool IsSlider() const { return Control == ESupercutControl::Slider; }
	bool IsValue() const { return Control == ESupercutControl::Slider || Control == ESupercutControl::Stepper; }
	/** What the row shows: "1.00", "80", "75%", "ON". */
	FString Shown() const;
	FString Format(float Value) const;
};

/**
 * The settings screen: its rows, which tab is open, which row is chosen, the scroll, typing on a slider. USupercutMenu

	using ETab = ESupercutTab;

	FSupercutSettingRow SettingsSlider(ETab Tab, const TCHAR* Section, const TCHAR* Label, float Lowest, float Highest, float Step, float Fine, int32 Decimals, float Default)
	{
		FSupercutSettingRow Row;
		Row.Tab = Tab;
		Row.Section = Section;
		Row.Label = Label;
		Row.Control = EControl::Slider;
		Row.Lowest = Lowest;
		Row.Highest = Highest;
		Row.Step = Step;
		Row.Fine = Fine;
		Row.Decimals = Decimals;
		Row.Default = Default;
		return Row;
	}

	FSupercutSettingRow SettingsStepper(ETab Tab, const TCHAR* Section, const TCHAR* Label, TArray<FString> Entries, int32 Default)
	{
		FSupercutSettingRow Row;
		Row.Tab = Tab;
		Row.Section = Section;
		Row.Label = Label;
		Row.Control = EControl::Stepper;
		Row.Entries = MoveTemp(Entries);
		Row.Lowest = 0.f;
		Row.Highest = float(Row.Entries.Num() - 1);
		Row.Default = float(Default);
		return Row;
	}

("""		const FLinearColor Strip = FMath::Lerp(Style.Ink, FLinearColor::White, Style.BandStripLighten).CopyWithNewOpacity(1.f);""",

		const FLinearColor Strip = FLinearColor::FromSRGBColor(FMath::Lerp(Style.Ink.ToFColorSRGB().ReinterpretAsLinear(), FLinearColor::White, Style.BandStripLighten).ToFColor(false));"""),

{

void USupercutUserSettings::SaveSettings()
{
	if (!bSizeForced)
	{
		Super::SaveSettings();
		return;
	}
	// The engine puts a -ResX window's size into the settings when the window opens; the next plain start must not get it.
	const FIntPoint Kept = DisplaySize(IsFullscreen(), GetDesktopResolution());
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("SETTINGS the window's %ux%u is forced by -ResX/-ResY: the file keeps %dx%d"), ResolutionSizeX, ResolutionSizeY, Kept.X, Kept.Y);

	const TGuardValue<uint32> ConfirmedX(LastUserConfirmedResolutionSizeX, uint32(Kept.X));
	const TGuardValue<uint32> ConfirmedY(LastUserConfirmedResolutionSizeY, uint32(Kept.Y));
	Super::SaveSettings();
}

if (!HasDevice())
	{
		UE_LOG(LogSupercutSound, Display, TEXT("SOUND no audio device: sounds are listed, not played, and the music is rendered silently"));
		return;
	}

	FAudioDevice* Device = InWorld.GetAudioDeviceRaw();
	const Audio::FMixerDevice* Mixer = static_cast<Audio::FMixerDevice*>(Device);
	UE_LOG(LogSupercutSound, Display, TEXT("SOUND mono upmix: the settings say %s, the mixer uses %s"),
		*UEnum::GetValueAsString(GetDefault<UAudioSettings>()->MonoChannelUpmixMethod), *UEnum::GetValueAsString(Mixer->GetMonoChannelUpmixMethod()));

	// The master limiter: the whole mix raised by the tuning's MasterGainDb, its peaks held under SoundMasterCeilingDb.
	// The player's VOLUME (SetMasterVolume) scales every source before it. -SupercutRawMix leaves it off, so a
	// recording of the same run shows what it does.
	const bool bRawMix = !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING && FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("SupercutRawMix"));
	if (!bRawMix)
	{
		MasterLimiter = NewObject<USubmixEffectDynamicsProcessorPreset>(this);
		FSubmixEffectDynamicsProcessorSettings& Limit = MasterLimiter->Settings;
		Limit.DynamicsProcessorType = ESubmixEffectDynamicsProcessorType::Limiter;
		Limit.PeakMode = ESubmixEffectDynamicsPeakMode::Peak;
		Limit.LinkMode = ESubmixEffectDynamicsChannelLinkMode::Peak;   // one gain for both sides: the image stays put
		Limit.InputGainDb = FSupercutTuning::Get().MasterGainDb;
		Limit.ThresholdDb = SoundMasterCeilingDb;
		Limit.KneeBandwidthDb = 0.f;
		Limit.LookAheadMsec = 2.f;      // the gain is down before the peak arrives; longer lets the release lift it first
		// 0, under the editor's 1 ms minimum: FAttackRelease takes 0 as an envelope that jumps to each peak. With 1 ms the
		// envelope only creeps toward a short crest, and gunshot peaks went 7 dB past the threshold.
		Limit.AttackTimeMsec = 0.f;
		Limit.ReleaseTimeMsec = 150.f;
		Limit.bAnalogMode = false;
	}
	MusicStop();
	PlayFlat(TEXT("wrap_sting"));
}

void USupercutAudio::SetMasterVolume(float Volume)
{
	checkf(Volume >= 0.f && Volume <= 1.f, TEXT("SetMasterVolume: %f is outside 0 to 1"), Volume);
	MasterVolume = Volume;
	if (HasDevice())
	{
		GetWorld()->GetAudioDeviceRaw()->SetTransientPrimaryVolume(Volume);
	}
	UE_LOG(LogSupercutSound, Display, TEXT("VOLUME master %.2f"), Volume);
}

void USupercutAudio::SetMusicVolume(float Volume)
{
	checkf(Volume >= 0.f && Volume <= 1.f, TEXT("SetMusicVolume: %f is outside 0 to 1"), Volume);
	MusicVolume = Volume;
	SendMusic([Volume](FSupercutMusicMixer& Mixer) { Mixer.SetVolume(Volume); });

void USupercutAudio::SendMusic(TUniqueFunction<void(FSupercutMusicMixer&)> Request)
{

void USupercutAudio::MusicTakeStart(ESupercutMusicCue Cue)
{

void USupercutAudio::MusicPlay(ESupercutMusicCue Cue)

```
void ASupercutCharacter::UpdateCameraKicks(float DeltaSeconds)
{
	const FSupercutTuning& Tuning = FSupercutTuning::Get();
	HurtKickLeft = FMath::Max(0.f, HurtKickLeft - DeltaSeconds);
	KillShakeLeft = FMath::Max(0.f, KillShakeLeft - DeltaSeconds);
	ClapViewKickLeft = FMath::Max(0.f, ClapViewKickLeft - DeltaSeconds);
	ReleaseKickLeft = FMath::Max(0.f, ReleaseKickLeft - DeltaSeconds);

	// Each dies out in a straight line over its own length. Max(Length, Left) keeps an F5 change to 0 safe.
	FRotator Kick = HurtKick * (HurtKickLeft / FMath::Max(Tuning.HurtKickSeconds, HurtKickLeft));
	if (KillShakeLeft > 0.f)
	{
		const float Since = Tuning.KillShakeSeconds - KillShakeLeft;
		Kick.Pitch += Tuning.KillShakeDegrees * (KillShakeLeft / FMath::Max(Tuning.KillShakeSeconds, KillShakeLeft))
			* FMath::Sin(UE_TWO_PI * Tuning.KillShakeHz * Since);
	}
	Kick.Pitch -= Tuning.ClapKickDegrees * (ClapViewKickLeft / FMath::Max(Tuning.ClapKickSeconds, ClapViewKickLeft));   // a nod down with the board
	Kick.Pitch += ReleaseKick * (ReleaseKickLeft / FMath::Max(Tuning.ClapKickSeconds, ReleaseKickLeft));   // up as the hanging shots fly (OnResumed)

	// The shot kicks stack (TryFire adds each one, up to FireKickMaxDegrees) and shrink back along their own line at the
	// speed that brings one full shot's kick back in FireKickSeconds, so a burst takes longer to settle than one shot.
	const float FireKickSize = FireKick.Euler().Size();
	if (FireKickSize > 0.f)
	{
		const float Speed = FVector2D(Tuning.FireKickDegrees, Tuning.FireKickSideDegrees).Size() / Tuning.FireKickSeconds;
		FireKick = Speed > 0.f ? FireKick * (FMath::Max(0.f, FireKickSize - Speed * DeltaSeconds) / FireKickSize) : FRotator::ZeroRotator;   // F5 to 0 mid-kick: gone at once
	}
	Kick += FireKick;

	// The camera's own additive offset: the view turns, the control rotation and the eye do not. The aim and the
	// walk direction come from the control rotation, so a kick moves neither.
	Camera->ClearAdditiveOffset();
	if (!Kick.IsNearlyZero(0.f))
	{
		Camera->AddAdditiveOffset(FTransform(Kick), 0.f);
	}
}

	TestEqual(TEXT("still FULLSCREEN"), Def.Shown(), FString(TEXT("FULLSCREEN")));
	TestEqual(TEXT("ui_deny once"), Menu.GetCueCount(Deny), 1);
	TArray<FSupercutUiElement> Elements;
	SupercutMenuView::Layout(Menu, UiW, UiH, Elements);
	const FSupercutUiElement* Chip = UiFindElement(Elements, { ESupercutUiKind::Less, Display });
	if (!TestNotNull(TEXT("the less chip is laid out"), Chip))
	{
		return false;
	}
	auto ChipIsDim = [&]()
	{
		FSupercutUiPainter Painter(nullptr, UiW, UiH, 0.0);
		SupercutMenuView::Draw(Painter, Menu);
		return Painter.Shapes.ContainsByPredicate([&](const FSupercutUiPainter::FShape& Shape) { return Shape.Box == Chip->Box && Shape.Color.Equals(Style.Dim()); });
	};
	TestTrue(TEXT("the chip is Dim at once"), ChipIsDim());
	World.Tick(0.12f);
	TestFalse(TEXT("and back after 100 ms"), ChipIsDim());
	TestTrue(TEXT("the flash is on that chip only"), Settings.GetSecondsSinceDenied(Display, false) >= 1000.f);

	// A slider at its end by key: ui_deny too.
	Settings.SetTab(ESupercutTab::Audio);
	USupercutUserSettings::Get().SetVolume(100);
	Menu.PressKey(EKeys::D);
	TestEqual(TEXT("D at 100 plays ui_deny"), Menu.GetCueCount(Deny), 2);
	TestEqual(TEXT("and leaves 100"), USupercutUserSettings::Get().GetVolume(), 100);
	return true;
}

float FSupercutUiPainter::TextWidth(const FString& String, float Cap)
{
	const TSharedPtr<FSlateFontMeasure> Measure = FEngineFontServices::Get().GetFontMeasure();
	checkf(Measure.IsValid(), TEXT("FSupercutUiPainter::TextWidth: the engine has no font measure service"));
	const FSlateFontInfo Font(GEngine->GetMediumFont(), FMath::RoundToInt(FontSize(Cap)), FName("Bold"));
	return float(FVector2D(Measure->Measure(String, Font)).X);
}

FVector2D FSupercutUiPainter::Text(const FString& String, const FVector2D& At, float Cap, const FLinearColor& Color, ESupercutUiAlign Align)
{
	const float Width = TextWidth(String, Cap);
	const float X = Offset.X + (Align == ESupercutUiAlign::Left ? At.X : (Align == ESupercutUiAlign::Centre ? At.X - Width * 0.5f : At.X - Width));
	const float Y = At.Y + Offset.Y;
	Texts.Add({ String, FBox2D(FVector2D(X, Y - Cap * 0.5f), FVector2D(X + Width, Y + Cap * 0.5f)) });
	if (!Canvas)
	{
		return FVector2D(Width, Cap);
	}
	// A canvas text item only draws a Slate font when the font info holds a UFont.
	const FSlateFontInfo Font(GEngine->GetMediumFont(), FMath::RoundToInt(FontSize(Cap)), FName("Bold"));
	FCanvasTextItem Item(FVector2D(X, Y), FText::FromString(String), Font, Color.CopyWithNewOpacity(Color.A * Alpha));

# tojpg.py <png dir> <out dir> <suffix>: every png -> jpg at most 960 wide
import sys, os
from PIL import Image
src, dst, suf = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
for n in sorted(os.listdir(src)):
    if not n.endswith('.png') or 'warmup' in n: continue
    im = Image.open(os.path.join(src, n)).convert('RGB')
    if im.width > 960:
        im = im.resize((960, round(im.height * 960 / im.width)), Image.LANCZOS)
    out = os.path.join(dst, n[:-4] + '_' + suf + '.jpg')
    im.save(out, quality=88)
    print(out)
```

ns = {}

# usage: python edfiles.py <src dir> <files.py>; files.py defines FILES = {name: EDITS}; each file keeps CRLF; all edits checked before any write
import sys, os
d, e = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
ns = {}
exec(open(e, encoding='utf-8').read(), ns)
out = {}
for name, edits in ns['FILES'].items():
    p = os.path.join(d, name)
    raw = open(p, newline='', encoding='utf-8').read()
    crlf = '\r\n' in raw
    s = raw.replace('\r\n', '\n')
    for old, new in edits:
        n = s.count(old)
        if n != 1:
            sys.exit(f'{name}: edit not found exactly once ({n}): {old[:80]!r}')
        s = s.replace(old, new)
    out[p] = s.replace('\n', '\r\n') if crlf else s
for p, s in out.items():
    open(p, 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8').write(s)
    print('ok', p)
EOF

void USupercutAudio::SetMasterVolume(float Volume)
{
	checkf(Volume >= 0.f && Volume <= 1.f, TEXT("SetMasterVolume: %f is outside 0 to 1"), Volume);
	MasterVolume = Volume;
	if (HasDevice())
	{
		GetWorld()->GetAudioDeviceRaw()->SetTransientPrimaryVolume(Volume);
	}
	UE_LOG(LogSupercutSound, Display, TEXT("VOLUME master %.2f"), Volume);
}

void USupercutAudio::SetMusicVolume(float Volume)
{
	checkf(Volume >= 0.f && Volume <= 1.f, TEXT("SetMusicVolume: %f is outside 0 to 1"), Volume);
	MusicVolume = Volume;
	SendMusic([Volume](FSupercutMusicMixer& Mixer) { Mixer.SetVolume(Volume); });
	UE_LOG(LogSupercutSound, Display, TEXT("VOLUME music %.2f"), Volume);
}

UAudioComponent* USupercutAudio::Start(FName CueName, USceneComponent* AttachTo, const FVector* At, float StartTime, float LoopFadeIn, float Volume, float Pitch)
{
	const FSupercutSoundCue& Cue = FindCue(CueName);
	const int32 CueIndex = int32(&Cue - SoundCueTable.GetData());
	checkf(Cue.bPlaced == (AttachTo || At), TEXT("SOUND: %s is %s"), Cue.Name, Cue.bPlaced ? TEXT("placed and needs a place") : TEXT("flat and cannot have a place"));

	// Variants: random, never the same twice in a row. The two hurt sounds alternate.
	int32 Variant = 0;
	if (Cue.Variants > 1)
	{
		if (FCString::Strcmp(Cue.Name, TEXT("hurt")) == 0)
		{
			Variant = (LastVariant[CueIndex] + 1) % Cue.Variants;
		}
		else
		{
			Variant = Random.RandRange(0, Cue.Variants - 2);
			Variant += Variant >= LastVariant[CueIndex] && LastVariant[CueIndex] >= 0 ? 1 : 0;
		}
	}
	LastVariant[CueIndex] = Variant;
	const FString File = SoundFileName(Cue, Variant);
	Asked.Add(File);
	AskedVolumes.Add(Volume);
	AskedPitches.Add(Pitch);

	if (!HasDevice())
	{
		UE_LOG(LogSupercutSound, Display, TEXT("START %s %s (no audio device)"), *File, Cue.bPlaced ? TEXT("placed") : TEXT("flat"));
		return nullptr;
	}

	UWorld* World = GetWorld();
	AActor* Owner = AttachTo ? AttachTo->GetOwner() : World->GetWorldSettings();
	UAudioComponent* Sound = NewObject<UAudioComponent>(Owner);
	Sound->SetSound(Waves[FirstWave[CueIndex] + Variant]);

void ASupercutCharacter::UpdateCameraKicks(float DeltaSeconds)
{
	const FSupercutTuning& Tuning = FSupercutTuning::Get();
	HurtKickLeft = FMath::Max(0.f, HurtKickLeft - DeltaSeconds);
	KillShakeLeft = FMath::Max(0.f, KillShakeLeft - DeltaSeconds);
	ClapViewKickLeft = FMath::Max(0.f, ClapViewKickLeft - DeltaSeconds);
	ReleaseKickLeft = FMath::Max(0.f, ReleaseKickLeft - DeltaSeconds);

	// Each dies out in a straight line over its own length. Max(Length, Left) keeps an F5 change to 0 safe.
	FRotator Kick = HurtKick * (HurtKickLeft / FMath::Max(Tuning.HurtKickSeconds, HurtKickLeft));
	if (KillShakeLeft > 0.f)
	{
		const float Since = Tuning.KillShakeSeconds - KillShakeLeft;
		Kick.Pitch += Tuning.KillShakeDegrees * (KillShakeLeft / FMath::Max(Tuning.KillShakeSeconds, KillShakeLeft))
			* FMath::Sin(UE_TWO_PI * Tuning.KillShakeHz * Since);
	}
	Kick.Pitch -= Tuning.ClapKickDegrees * (ClapViewKickLeft / FMath::Max(Tuning.ClapKickSeconds, ClapViewKickLeft));   // a nod down with the board
	Kick.Pitch += ReleaseKick * (ReleaseKickLeft / FMath::Max(Tuning.ClapKickSeconds, ReleaseKickLeft));   // up as the hanging shots fly (OnResumed)

	// The shot kicks stack (TryFire adds each one, up to FireKickMaxDegrees) and shrink back along their own line at the
	// speed that brings one full shot's kick back in FireKickSeconds, so a burst takes longer to settle than one shot.
	const float FireKickSize = FireKick.Euler().Size();
	if (FireKickSize > 0.f)
	{
		const float Speed = FVector2D(Tuning.FireKickDegrees, Tuning.FireKickSideDegrees).Size() / Tuning.FireKickSeconds;
		FireKick = Speed > 0.f ? FireKick * (FMath::Max(0.f, FireKickSize - Speed * DeltaSeconds) / FireKickSize) : FRotator::ZeroRotator;   // F5 to 0 mid-kick: gone at once
	}
	Kick += FireKick;

	// The camera's own additive offset: the view turns, the control rotation and the eye do not. The aim and the
	// walk direction come from the control rotation, so a kick moves neither.
	Camera->ClearAdditiveOffset();
	if (!Kick.IsNearlyZero(0.f))
	{
		Camera->AddAdditiveOffset(FTransform(Kick), 0.f);
	}
}

void ASupercutHUD::DrawHUD()
{
	Super::DrawHUD();
	if (!Canvas)
	{
		return;
	}

	const FSupercutTuning& Tuning = FSupercutTuning::Get();
	const float W = Canvas->ClipX;
	const float H = Canvas->ClipY;
	const float S = H / 720.f;   // every size below is in 720p pixels
	const FLinearColor White(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.92f);
	const FLinearColor Dim(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 0.22f);
	const FLinearColor Gold(1.f, 0.8f, 0.2f, 1.f);
	const FLinearColor Red(1.f, 0.16f, 0.1f, 1.f);
	const FLinearColor PaleYellow(1.f, 0.95f, 0.6f, 0.95f);   // [pick] the kill marker

	USupercutTime& Time = USupercutTime::Get(this);
	const USupercutRun& Run = USupercutRun::Get(this);
	const ASupercutCharacter* Player = Cast<ASupercutCharacter>(GetOwningPawn());
	const bool bFrozen = Time.IsFrozen();
	const float Since = Time.GetSecondsSinceChange();
	const bool bEverFroze = Time.GetFreezeCount() > 0;
	const USupercutMenu& Menu = USupercutMenu::Get(this);
	if (Run.GetPhase() == ESupercutRunPhase::Title)
	{
		DrawMenu(Menu, W, H, S);   // the frozen first room behind it, nothing of the game's HUD
		return;
	}

		DrawWrapScreen(Run, W, H, S);
	}

	DrawTuningAndPractice(W, H, S, BarFull);
	if (bMenuOpen)
	{
		DrawMenu(Menu, W, H, S);
	}
}

void SupercutMenuView::DrawOverlay(FSupercutUiPainter& Painter, int32 Mode, float FrameSeconds)
{
	if (Mode == 0)
	{
		return;
	}
	checkf(FrameSeconds > 0.f, TEXT("DrawOverlay: frame time %f"), FrameSeconds);
	const FSupercutUiStyle& Style = Painter.Style;
	const FLinearColor Color = Style.Chalk.CopyWithNewOpacity(Style.OverlayAlpha);
	const FVector2D At(Style.OverlayRightW * Painter.W, Style.OverlayTopH * Painter.H);
	Painter.Text(FString::Printf(TEXT("%d FPS"), FMath::RoundToInt(1.f / FrameSeconds)), At, Style.OverlayCap * Painter.H, Color, ESupercutUiAlign::Right);
	if (Mode == 2)
	{
		Painter.Text(FString::Printf(TEXT("%.1f MS"), FrameSeconds * 1000.f), At + FVector2D(0.f, Style.OverlayLineH * Painter.H), Style.OverlayCap * Painter.H, Color, ESupercutUiAlign::Right);
	}
}'''),

{
	if (!bSizeForced)
	{
		Super::SaveSettings();
		return;
	}
	// The engine puts a -ResX window's size into the settings when the window opens; the next plain start must not get it.
	const FIntPoint Kept = DisplaySize(IsFullscreen(), GetDesktopResolution());
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("SETTINGS the window's %ux%u is forced by -ResX/-ResY: the file keeps %dx%d"), ResolutionSizeX, ResolutionSizeY, Kept.X, Kept.Y);

	const TGuardValue<uint32> SizeY(ResolutionSizeY, uint32(Kept.Y));
	const TGuardValue<uint32> ConfirmedX(LastUserConfirmedResolutionSizeX, uint32(Kept.X));
	const TGuardValue<uint32> ConfirmedY(LastUserConfirmedResolutionSizeY, uint32(Kept.Y));
	Super::SaveSettings();
}

	if (bWindow)

	ApplyNonResolutionSettings();
	SaveSettings();
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("SETTINGS saved: %s"), *Describe());

bool FSupercutSettingsScreen::Commit(int32 Row, float Value)
{
	const FSupercutSettingRow& Def = Rows()[Row];
	// What the row will show, from the value set: a row that reads the open window (DISPLAY MODE) shows the change a frame later.
	const FString Before = Def.Shown();
	const FString After = Def.Format(FMath::Clamp(Value, Def.Lowest, Def.Highest));
	if (After == Before)
	{
		return false;
	}
	Def.Set(Value);
	USupercutUserSettings::Get().ApplyAndSave(Def.bWindow);
	Applied();
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("MENU set %s %s to %s"), *Def.Label, *Before, *After);
	return true;
}

bool FSupercutSettingsScreen::Change(int32 Row, int32 Steps, bool bFine, bool bRound)
{
	const FSupercutSettingRow& Def = Rows()[Row];
	const float Was = Def.Get();
	float Next = Was;
	if (Def.Control == EControl::Stepper)
	{
		const int32 Count = Def.Entries.Num();
		const int32 Index = FMath::RoundToInt(Was) + Steps;
		Next = float(bRound ? (Index % Count + Count) % Count : FMath::Clamp(Index, 0, Count - 1));
	}
	else
	{
		// To the next point on the step's grid, so 0.86 and a step down of 0.05 gives 0.85.
		const float Step = bFine ? Def.Fine : Def.Step;
		const float OnGrid = Was / Step;
		const float Points = Steps > 0 ? FMath::FloorToFloat(OnGrid + 0.01f) + Steps : FMath::CeilToFloat(OnGrid - 0.01f) + Steps;
		Next = FMath::Clamp(Points * Step, Def.Lowest, Def.Highest);
	}
	return Commit(Row, Next);
}

#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "InputCoreTypes.h"

/** The settings screen's six tabs (UI_SPEC section 3). */
enum class ESupercutTab : uint8
{
	Gameplay,
	Crosshair,
	Controls,
	Accessibility,
	Audio,
	Video,
	Count
};

/** How a settings row is changed. */
enum class ESupercutControl : uint8
{
	Stepper,   // one entry of a list, two arrow chips
	Slider,    // a number on a track
	Action,    // a button (RESET)
	Keys,      // two key boxes
	Fixed,     // shown, never changed (PAUSE: Esc)
};

/** One row of the settings screen. Values are floats in the row's own units; a stepper's value is its entry's index. */
struct FSupercutSettingRow
{
	ESupercutTab Tab = ESupercutTab::Gameplay;
	FString Section;          // the header shown above the first row of each section
	FString Label;
	ESupercutControl Control = ESupercutControl::Stepper;
	float Lowest = 0.f;
	float Highest = 1.f;
	float Step = 1.f;         // the arrows and a click on a chip
	float Fine = 1.f;         // Shift and the arrows; dragging keeps to this too
	int32 Decimals = 0;
	FString Suffix;           // "%" on a percentage
	TArray<FString> Entries;  // a stepper's entries
	bool bWindow = false;     // applying it changes the window (DISPLAY)
	bool bResets = true;      // X puts it back to Default
	float Default = 0.f;
	TFunction<float()> Get;
	TFunction<void(float)> Set;      // keeps the value in range; the screen saves after it
	TFunction<bool()> Enabled;       // unset: always

	bool IsEnabled() const { return Control != ESupercutControl::Fixed && (!Enabled || Enabled()); }
	bool IsSlider() const { return Control == ESupercutControl::Slider; }
	bool IsValue() const { return Control == ESupercutControl::Slider || Control == ESupercutControl::Stepper; }
	/** What the row shows: "1.00", "80", "75%", "ON". */
	FString Shown() const;
	FString Format(float Value) const;
};

void ASupercutPlayerController::ReadKeys(FSupercutInput& Input)
{
	Input.Forward = (IsInputKeyDown(EKeys::W) ? 1.f : 0.f) - (IsInputKeyDown(EKeys::S) ? 1.f : 0.f);
	Input.Right = (IsInputKeyDown(EKeys::D) ? 1.f : 0.f) - (IsInputKeyDown(EKeys::A) ? 1.f : 0.f);

	float MouseX = 0.f;
	float MouseY = 0.f;
	GetInputMouseDelta(MouseX, MouseY);
	MouseLook(MouseX, MouseY, Input);

	Input.bJump = WasInputKeyJustPressed(EKeys::SpaceBar);
	Input.bJumpHeld = IsInputKeyDown(EKeys::SpaceBar);
	Input.bClap = WasInputKeyJustPressed(EKeys::RightMouseButton);
	Input.bReload = WasInputKeyJustPressed(EKeys::R);

	// The click that picked a card must not also fire a shot in the next room.
	bFireLocked = bFireLocked && IsInputKeyDown(EKeys::LeftMouseButton);
	Input.bFire = !bFireLocked && IsInputKeyDown(EKeys::LeftMouseButton);
}

	void ViewSettingsLayout(const USupercutMenu& Menu, float W, float H, TArray<FSupercutUiElement>& Out)
	{
		const TArray<FBox2D> Tabs = ViewTabBoxes(W, H);
		for (int32 Tab = 0; Tab < Tabs.Num(); ++Tab)
		{
			Out.Add({ Tabs[Tab], { ESupercutUiKind::Tab, Tab } });
		}
		for (const FViewItem& Shown : ViewSettingsItems(Menu.GetSettings(), W, H))
		{
			const int32 Row = Shown.Item.Row;
			if (Row == INDEX_NONE || !FSupercutSettingsScreen::Rows()[Row].IsEnabled())
			{
				continue;   // a header or a disabled row takes no pointer
			}
			Out.Add({ Shown.Box, { ESupercutUiKind::Row, Row } });
			if (FSupercutSettingsScreen::Rows()[Row].IsSlider())
			{
				Out.Add({ ViewTrack(Shown.Box, W, H), { ESupercutUiKind::Track, Row } });
			}
			else if (FSupercutSettingsScreen::Rows()[Row].IsValue())
			{
				Out.Add({ ViewChip(Shown.Box, true, W, H), { ESupercutUiKind::Less, Row } });
				Out.Add({ ViewChip(Shown.Box, false, W, H), { ESupercutUiKind::More, Row } });
			}
		}
	}
