#pragma once

#include "CoreMinimal.h"
#include "GameFramework/GameUserSettings.h"
#include "SupercutCrosshair.h"
#include "Misc/CommandLine.h"
#include "SupercutUserSettings.generated.h"

/**
 * The settings screen's four values. They live in the engine's own user settings: Config/DefaultEngine.ini names this
 * class as the engine's GameUserSettingsClassName, so the engine loads it at start and it saves to the same file
 * (GameUserSettings.ini in the saved config folder, FilePath()).
 *
 *   Sensitivity  multiplies the tuning's LookDegreesPerMouseUnit, 0.2 to 3.0: the arrows step 0.05, a typed value keeps 0.01
 *   Volume       the master volume, 0 to 100 in steps of 1
 *   Quality      the engine's overall scalability level, 0 LOW to 3 EPIC. On the first title screen the engine's
 *                hardware benchmark picks it: one level under the lowest it gives any group, and only MEDIUM or HIGH
 *   Display      FULLSCREEN (windowed fullscreen at the desktop size) or WINDOW (1600x900, smaller on a smaller desktop)
 *
 * The setters change values only. ApplyAndSave applies them and writes the file; the settings screen calls it after
 * each change. The engine itself reads the window size, window mode and quality from the file at the next start.
 * A window size forced with -ResX or -ResY is for that run only: every save writes the size DISPLAY gives instead.
 */
UCLASS(config = GameUserSettings, configdonotcheckdefaults)
class USupercutUserSettings : public UGameUserSettings
{
	GENERATED_BODY()

public:
	/** The engine's user settings object. Fails loudly if the engine made another class (a missing ini line). */
	static USupercutUserSettings& Get();

	static constexpr float SensitivityLowest = 0.2f;
	static constexpr float SensitivityHighest = 3.f;
	static constexpr float SensitivityStep = 0.05f;   // the settings screen's arrows
	static constexpr int32 VolumeStep = 1;
	static constexpr int32 HighestQuality = 3;   // EPIC

	virtual void SetToDefaults() override;
	/** As the engine's, except that under a size forced with -ResX/-ResY the file gets DisplaySize, not the window's size. */
	 */
	static int32 FirstStartLevel(int32 BenchmarkLowest);

	/** The window WINDOW opens on a desktop of this size: 1600x900, scaled down to fit in 90 percent of a smaller desktop. */
	static FIntPoint WindowSize(const FIntPoint& Desktop);
	/** The size DISPLAY sets: the desktop for FULLSCREEN, WindowSize for WINDOW. */
	static FIntPoint DisplaySize(bool bFullscreen, const

void ASupercutPlayerController::CheckPracticeKeysAreFree()
{
#if !UE_BUILD_SHIPPING
	if (bPracticeKeysChecked || !PlayerInput)
	{
		return;
	}
	bPracticeKeysChecked = true;
	// The engine's BaseInput.ini binds F1 to F5 and F9 to debug view modes. Config/DefaultInput.ini takes those away;
	// a key still bound would do both things at once.
	for (const FKey& Key : USupercutPractice::Keys())
	{
		const FString Command = PlayerInput->GetBind(Key);
		if (!Command.IsEmpty())
		{
			UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Fatal, TEXT("Practice key %s is also the engine's debug key for \"%s\". Remove that DebugExecBindings line in Config/DefaultInput.ini."), *Key.ToString(), *Command);
		}
	}
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("PRACTICE keys on (-SupercutDev): %d keys, none bound to an engine debug command"), USupercutPractice::Keys().Num());
#endif
}

bool FSupercutUiSettingsRoundTripTest::RunTest(const FString& Parameters)
{
	const FUiSettingsKeeper Keeper;
	USupercutUserSettings& Settings = USupercutUserSettings::Get();
	const TArray<FSupercutSettingRow>& Rows = FSupercutSettingsScreen::Rows();

	for (int32 Row = 0; Row < Rows.Num(); ++Row)
	{

		// DISPLAY changes the window under the test. The scalability rows save through the engine's scalability state,
		// not a value of this object: their own test is QualityGroupsAndRenderResolutionSaveThroughTheEngine.
		if (!Def.IsValue() || Def.bWindow || UiScalabilityRow(Def))
		{
			continue;
		}
		Def.Set(Def.Highest + 50.f);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Step 0: cues and square corners

IMPLEMENT_SIMPLE_AUTOMATION_TEST(FSupercutUiCueTest, "Supercut.Ui.EveryElementCuesOnceOnHoverAndOnceOnClick", UiTestFlags)
bool FSupercutUiCueTest::RunTest(const FString& Parameters)
{
	const FUiSettingsKeeper Keeper;
	int32 Checked = 0;
	for (const FUiTestPlace& Screen : UiTestPlaces())
	{
		// How many elements the screen has, from one world; then one fresh world per element, since a click can leave the screen.
		int32 Count = 0;
		{
			FUiTestWorld World;
			if (!TestTrue(TEXT("test world starts"), World.Start()) || !UiOpenScreen(*this, World, Screen))
			{
				return false;
			}
			TArray<FSupercutUiElement> Elements;
			SupercutMenuView::Layout(World.Menu(), UiW, UiH, Elements);
			Count = Elements.Num();
			TestTrue(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s: has elements"), *UiTestPlaceName(Screen)), Count > 0);
		}
		for (int32 Index = 0; Index < Count; ++Index)
		{
			FUiTestWorld World;
			if (!TestTrue(TEXT("test world starts"), World.Start()) || !UiOpenScreen(*this, World, Screen))
			{
				return false;
			}
			USupercutMenu& Menu = World.Menu();
			TArray<FSupercutUiElement> Elements;
			SupercutMenuView::Layout(Menu, UiW, UiH, Elements);
			const FSupercutUiElement Element = Elements[Index];
			const FString Where = FString::Printf(TEXT("%s, %s"), *UiTestPlaceName(Screen), *Element.Target.Describe());
			TestEqual(Where + TEXT(": the hit test finds the element at its centre"), SupercutMenuView::HitTest(Menu, UiW, UiH, Element.Box.GetCenter()), Element.Target);

			Menu.PointAt(FSupercutUiTarget());
			const int32 Moves = Menu.GetCueCount(UiMove);
			Menu.PointAt(SupercutMenuView::HitTest(Menu, UiW, UiH, Element.Box.GetCenter()));
			TestEqual(Where + TEXT(": entering plays ui_move once"), Menu.GetCueCount(UiMove), Moves + 1);
			Menu.PointAt(SupercutMenuView::HitTest(Menu, UiW, UiH, Element.Box.GetCenter() + FVector2D(1.f, 0.f)));
			TestEqual(Where + TEXT(": moving inside plays nothing"), Menu.GetCueCount(UiMove), Moves + 1);

			const int32 Picks = Menu.GetCueCount(UiPick);
			Menu.ClickOn(Element.Target);
			TestEqual(Where + TEXT(": a click plays ui_pick once"), Menu.GetCueCount(UiPick), Picks + 1);
			Menu.TakeQuitRequest();
			++Checked;
		}
	}
	AddInfo(FString::Printf(TEXT("%d elements checked"), Checked));
	return true;
}

bool FSupercutUiCameraTest::RunTest(const FString& Parameters)
{
	const FUiSettingsKeeper Keeper;

	TMap<int32, float> Kicks;
	for (const int32 Shake : { 100, 50, 0 })
	{
		User.SetCameraShake(Shake);
		User.SetMotionBlur(Shake == 50);
		FTestWorldWrapper World;
		if (!TestTrue(TEXT("test world"), World.CreateTestWorld(EWorldType::Game)))
		{
			return false;
		}
		World.GetTestWorld()->GetWorldSettings()->DefaultGameMode = AGameModeBase::StaticClass();
		if (!TestTrue(TEXT("begin play"), World.BeginPlayInTestWorld()))
		{
			return false;
		}
		FActorSpawnParameters Params;
		Params.SpawnCollisionHandlingOverride = ESpawnActorCollisionHandlingMethod::AlwaysSpawn;
		ASupercutPlayerController* Controller = World.GetTestWorld()->SpawnActor<ASupercutPlayerController>(FVector::ZeroVector, FRotator::ZeroRotator, Params);
		Controller->SetAsLocalPlayerController();
		USupercutRun::Get(World.GetTestWorld()).Begin({ TEXT("tests/plain") }, 1);
		ASupercutCharacter* Hero = USupercutRun::Get(World.GetTestWorld()).GetHero();
		if (!TestNotNull(TEXT("a hero"), Hero))
		{
			return false;
		}
		for (int32 Tick = 0; Tick < 50; ++Tick)
		{
			World.TickTestWorld(UiTestStep);
		}
		TestNotNull(TEXT("a shot"), Hero->TryFire());
		World.TickTestWorld(UiTestStep);
		UCameraComponent* Camera = Hero->FindComponentByClass<UCameraComponent>();
		FTransform Offset;
		float Fov = 0.f;
		Camera->GetAdditiveOffset(Offset, Fov);
		Kicks.Add(Shake, Offset.Rotator().Pitch);
		TestEqual(FString::Printf(TEXT("MOTION BLUR %s: the camera's blur amount"), Shake == 50 ? TEXT("on") : TEXT("off")), Camera->PostProcessSettings.MotionBlurAmount, Shake == 50 ? 0.5f : 0.f);
	}
	AddInfo(FString::Printf(TEXT("kick pitch: 100 %% %.4f, 50 %% %.4f, 0 %% %.4f"), Kicks[100], Kicks[50], Kicks[0]));
	TestTrue(TEXT("a shot kicks the view at 100 %"), FMath::Abs(Kicks[100]) > 0.1f);
	TestTrue(TEXT("half as much at 50 %"), FMath::IsNearlyEqual(Kicks[50], Kicks[100] * 0.5f, 1.e-3f));
	TestTrue(TEXT("none at 0 %"), FMath::Abs(Kicks[0]) < 1.e-4f);
	return true;
}

#!/bin/bash
# usage: pipe.sh <tag> [from-step] [to-step]   steps: build test package main8 shots
# Runs lane ui1's checks on [pc-c] with FARM.md's load check before each heavy step. Logs per step under /d/UE/wt/ui1_farmlogs/<tag>.
S="C:/Users/USER/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/ce66ae306241b5fa/c0b1a6a8-6ed1-4de6-9c48-699082447a7f/scratchpad"
F="[notes]/unreal/megajam-2026/farm/farm.sh"
TAG=$1; FROM=${2:-build}
L=/d/UE/wt/ui1_farmlogs/$TAG; mkdir -p "$L"
EXE='{B}\Supercut59\Windows\Supercut.exe'
INI='F:\UE\Farm\_builds\ui1\Supercut59\Windows\Supercut\Saved\Config\Windows\GameUserSettings.ini'
wait_ok() { bash "$S/waitfarm.sh" | tail -1 | sed 's/^/  load ok /' || { echo "load check never passed"; exit 1; }; }
go=0
TO=${3:-shots}; done_=0
step() { [ "$1" = "$FROM" ] && go=1; [ $go = 1 ] && [ $done_ = 0 ] || return 1; [ "$1" = "$TO" ] && done_=1; return 0; }
if step build; then
  # The mirror keeps c4's file times: a file edited before [pc-c]'s last build would look older than its object file.
  ( cd /d/UE/wt/ui1 && git diff --name-only HEAD -- Source | xargs -r touch )
  wait_ok; "$F" mirror [pc-c] ui1 /d/UE/wt/ui1 | tail -1
  "$F" build [pc-c] ui1 "$L/b" -Jobs 6 | tail -1
  grep -q "exit=0" "$L/b/build/farm_step.txt" 2>/dev/null || { grep -E "error" "$L/b/build/ubt_SupercutEditor.log" | head; echo "BUILD FAILED"; exit 1; }
fi
if step test; then
  wait_ok; "$F" test [pc-c] ui1 "$L/t" | tail -2
  grep -E "Result=\{Fail" "$L/t/test/tests.log" | cut -c1-200 | head
fi
if step package; then
  for try in $(seq 1 40); do
    wait_ok; "$F" package [pc-c] ui1 "$L/p" | tail -1
    grep -q "conflicting instance of AutomationTool" "$L/p/package/package_run.log" || break
    echo "  another lane's AutomationTool is running: retry in 60 s"; sleep 60
  done
  grep -q "exit=0" "$L/p/package/farm_step.txt" || { echo "PACKAGE FAILED"; exit 1; }
fi
if step main8; then
  for i in 1 2; do
    wait_ok
    ssh [pc-c] "if exist \"$INI\" del \"$INI\"" ; echo "  settings file cleared"
    "$F" run [pc-c] ui1 "$L/m$i" -Packaged -Exe "$EXE" -Run main8 -Seed 1 -Script '{P}\Script\main8.txt' -FixedFps 240 -Silent | tail -1
    grep -h "RUN wrapped" "$L/m$i/run/run.log" | sed 's/.*RUN wrapped/  RUN wrapped/'
  done
fi

S="C:/Users/USER/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/ce66ae306241b5fa/c0b1a6a8-6ed1-4de6-9c48-699082447a7f/scratchpad"; cat > "$S/e5_script.py" <<'EOF'
import sys, re
p = sys.argv[1]
s = open(p, newline='').read()
lines = s.split('\r\n')
out = []
room = False
for line in lines:
    m = re.match(r'^(\d+\.\d+) (.*)$', line)
    if line.startswith('0 scene'):
        room = True
    if m and not room:
        t = float(m.group(1))
        if t > 5.50:
            line = '%.2f %s' % (t + 1.4, m.group(2))
        elif t > 4.90:
            line = '%.2f %s' % (t + 0.9, m.group(2))
    out.append(line)
    if line == '4.90 key X':
        out += ['5.00 key Down', '5.03 key Down', '5.10 key Enter', '5.30 shot ui_settings_controls_press_key',
                '5.40 key S', '5.60 shot ui_settings_controls_swapped', '5.70 key X']
    if line == '6.40 shot ui_settings_accessibility':
        out += ['6.50 key D', '6.70 shot ui_settings_accessibility_protanopia', '6.80 key A']
s = '\r\n'.join(out)
old = '# On CONTROLS: 0.8 typed on SENSITIVITY (the log\'s "MENU drawn" lines give the text\'s and the track\'s centres), Enter, X back to 1.00.'
assert s.count(old) == 1
s = s.replace(old, old + '\r\n# Then down to FORWARD, Enter: PRESS KEY; S: FORWARD and BACK swap; X back. On ACCESSIBILITY: D for PROTANOPIA, A back.')
assert s.count('5.30 shot ui_settings_controls_press_key') == 1 and s.count('6.70 shot ui_settings_accessibility_protanopia') == 1
open(p, 'w', newline='').write(s)
print('ok')
EOF

#!/bin/bash
# waits until [pc-c] passes FARM.md's load check; prints the passing status
F="[notes]/unreal/megajam-2026/farm/farm.sh"
for i in $(seq 1 90); do
  out=$("$F" status [pc-c] 2>&1)
  cpu=$(echo "$out" | sed -n 's/^cpu_load_pct=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
  ram=$(echo "$out" | sed -n 's/^free_ram_gb=\([0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' | cut -d. -f1)
  busy=$(echo "$out" | grep '^busy_procs=')
  if ! echo "$busy" | grep -q Supercut && ! echo "$busy" | grep -q UnrealEditor && [ "${cpu:-100}" -lt 60 ] && [ "${ram:-0}" -ge 6 ]; then
    date +%H:%M; echo "$out"; exit 0
  fi
  echo "$(date +%H:%M) wait cpu=$cpu ram=$ram $busy"
  sleep 60
done
exit 1
fi
if step shots; then
  for R in "1920 1080" "1280 720"; do
    set -- $R
    wait_ok
    "$F" run [pc-c] ui1 "$L/s$2" -Packaged -Exe "$EXE" -Title -Seed 1 -Script '{P}\Script\ui1_menus.txt' -FixedFps 240 -Silent -ResX $1 -ResY $2 | tail -1
    ls "$L/s$2/run/shots" | tr '\n' ' '; echo
  done
fi
date +%H:%M
02:07
b
p
t

## What the wrapper does and does not do

- `mirror` sends only files whose size or time differ, keeps file times (so builds stay incremental), never sends
  `Intermediate`, `Binaries`, `Saved`, `DerivedDataCache` or `.git`, and deletes files under `Source`, `Content`,
  `Config`, `Tools` and `Script` that are gone on c4. Files elsewhere in the mirror (`Art`, `Audio`) are never deleted.
  It mirrors whatever is in the folder you give it, committed or not. It does not commit, pull or push.
- The project's Tools scripts name c4's `D:\UE\UE_5.9` and `D:\UE\Builds`. The farm does not edit them: each step
  writes a copy beside the script, `Tools\farm_<file>`, with those paths changed to the PC's, and runs the copy
  (`farm/remote/step.ps1`). If a Tools script gains another `D:\` path, the step stops and says so.
- The `run` copy also gets `-RenderOffscreen` (next section). Nothing else is changed.
- It does not start the Epic Launcher, sign in, install anything or touch anything outside `<root>`.

## Limits

- **Runs are offscreen.** ssh runs in session 0: the GPU is there, but a game window cannot get a swap chain
  (`DXGI_ERROR_NOT_CURRENTLY_AVAILABLE` in `FD3D12Viewport::Init`, exit 3 in 3 s). With `-RenderOffscreen` the game
```

uses the HUD's frozen colour |\n| GAMEPLAY, KEY HINTS | ON | OFF, ON | game: the menus' hint row |\n| ACCESSIBILITY, COLOUR-BLIND MODE | OFF | OFF, PROTANOPIA, DEUTERANOPIA, TRITANOPIA | `FSlateRenderer::SetColorVisionDeficiencyType` (`Runtime/SlateCore/Public/Rendering/SlateRenderer.h:335`), severity 10, correction on |\n| ACCESSIBILITY, CAMERA SHAKE | 100 % | 0 to 100 %, step 10 | scales the kick given to `UCameraComponent::AddAdditiveOffset` (`Runtime/Engine/Classes/Camera/CameraComponent.h:330`) |\n\nEvery row above is clamped on set and read back; It is not on my base and I did not add it. Its place is the VIDEO tab, section UPSCALING, in a new block just above the RENDER RESOLUTION block in `FSupercutSettingsScreen::Rows()` ([SupercutSettingsScreen.cpp](<D:/UE/wt/ui1/Source/Supercut/SupercutSettingsScreen.cpp>), the comment that names it sits right above RENDER RESOLUTION). Build it with `SettingsStepper(ETab::Video, TEXT(\"UPSCALING\"), TEXT(\"DLSS MODE\"), {names}, default)`, `Row.Get`/`Row.Set` on the settings object, `Row.Enabled = [] { return SupercutDlss::IsSupported(); }`. `Commit` already calls `ApplyAndSave(false)`. If DLSS on should grey RENDER RESOLUTION, give that row an `Enabled` too. Then add the row's label to the round-trip test's list or exclude it like the scalability rows if it saves through the engine.\n- **HUD lane.** Its settings rows go on GAMEPLAY under a HUD section, beside KEY HINTS (same `Rows()` function, `SettingsSwitch`/`SettingsSlider`). The crosshair is drawn in `ASupercutHUD::DrawHUD` from `FSupercutCrosshair::Marks`; leave that block and the `DrawOverlay(W, H)` call at the end of `DrawHUD` in place. The HUD's \"RIGHT MOUSE\" clap label should read the binding: `FSupercutKeyBindings::KeyLabel(USupercutUserSettings::Get().GetKeys().Get(ESupercutAction::Clap, 0))`. B4's teaching prompts should read the bindings the same way. The HUD's TAKE 1 label shows faintly through the pause panel next to PAUSED; moving it is the HUD lane's.\n\n## Sound hooks\n\nThe menus play cues by name through `USupercutMenu::PlayCue`; every cue is counted (`GetCueCount`) and logged as `UI cue <name>`.\n\n- Real sounds: `ui_move` (hover enters an element), `ui_pick` (click, Enter, a tab change, a key bound), `ui_open` (a screen opens).\n- Named hooks that play nothing yet (no asset): `ui_back` (Esc back, band closed, key wait cancelled), `ui_deny` (range end, a key that cannot be bound), `ui_tick` (a slider drag passes a step). The list is `Hooks` in [SupercutMenu.cpp](<D:/UE/wt/ui1/Source/Supercut/SupercutMenu.cpp>); give one a sound by adding it to the cue table in `SupercutAudio.cpp` and removing it from `Hooks`.\n- EFFECTS scales every cue but the `ui_` ones (B5's INTERFACE row will scale those). It applies to the next sound started; a bed already playing keeps its level.\n\n## [taste: owner review]\n\n- Every colour and size in direction A's `FSupercutUiStyle::Get()`, as the spec gives them; the ones I chose are tagged in the code: the key boxes (each 0.48 of the control column, black 18 % fill, grey 30 % on the chosen row, cap 0.015 H) and the 530 ms PRESS KEY blink; the overlay (cap 0.014 H, 85 %, top right at 0.978 W, 0.03 H); the crosshair ranges and the preview squares (#c4c3be, #2b2c2e).\n- Defaults: MASTER, MUSIC and EFFECTS stay 100, as the game is today; the spec says MASTER 80 and MUSIC 80.\n- Crosshair defaults follow today's crosshair (white 92 %, gold while frozen), not the spec's Chalk with cyan; the brief says the default equals today's.\n- The small QUIT block's label sits on the hatch and reads less clearly than START.\n\n## Checks and results\n\nEvery step: build, all tests, package, main8 twice, pictures at both sizes compared with the mock. Builds A0 to A4 and A3 ran on [pc-c]; A5's package and runs moved to [pc-b] ([pc-c] busy with its user's load).\n\n| Step | Tests | main8 run 1 and run 2 | Pictures |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 0 | 131 passed, 0 failed | `RUN wrapped: takes 1, time 98.2 s, shots 46, freezes 14, kills 17` both | match |\n| A1 | 134 / 0 | same line both | match |\n| A2 | 137 / 0 | same line both | match; typed text centre equals track centre at both sizes |\n| A6 | 140 / 0 | same line both | match |\n| A7 | 143 / 0 | same line both | match after the strip colour fix |\n| A4 | 146 / 0 | same line both | match |\n| A3 | 150 / 0 | same line both | match |\n| A5 | A5_TESTS | A5_MAIN8 | A5_SHOTS |\n\nBrief proofs, and the test that holds each:\n- Every setting saved, clamped and read back: `Supercut.Ui.EverySettingKeepsToItsRangeSavesAndReadsBackAfterAReload`, plus `QualityGroupsAndRenderResolutionSaveThroughTheEngineAndOverallShowsCustom` and the display test.\n- A rebind swaps two keys and survives a restart of the settings object: `Supercut.Ui.ARebindSwapsTwoKeysAndSurvivesARestartOfTheSettings` (FORWARD gets S, BACK gets W, then a scramble and `LoadSettings(true)` reads them back). `AReboundKeyWalksTheHeroAndTheOldKeyNoLongerDoes`: FORWARD on I, 0.5 s held walks the hero 267 cm on I and 0 cm on W.\n- The pause panel opens from the left and closes: the A7 slide tests (frame 0 at -115 px, in place by 0.4 s; the world still paused at 0.07 s after Esc, rolling by 0.15 s).\n- One hover cue and one click cue per clickable element, no corner radius: `EveryElementCuesOnceOnHoverAndOnceOnClick` and `NoElementHasARoundedCorner` over the title, pause, band and all six tabs (key boxes included).\n- The default crosshair equals today's: `TheDefaultCrosshairIsTheOldOnePixelForPixel` at heights 480 to 2160, frozen and not.\n\n## What was not checked\n\n- No real keyboard or mouse: every input came from tests or scripts. A person has not rebound a key with a real keyboard.\n- COLOUR-BLIND MODE on screen: A5_COLOURBLIND. The spec's check that the four signal hues still part under each mode is not done.\n- Frame rate on a desktop session (farm runs are offscreen).\n- Pictures at sizes other than 1920x1080 and 1280x720.\n- Sounds aloud (all runs `-Silent`); the cue counts and log lines are the proof.\n- Enhanced Input: not used (below).\n\n## Merge difficulties\n\n- **Key bindings are not Enhanced Input.** The spec names it. 5.9's `UEnhancedInputUserSettings` (`Plugins/EnhancedInput/Source/EnhancedInput/Public/UserSettings/EnhancedInputUserSettings.h:516`) is a `USaveGame` with its own slot that remaps keys of input mapping contexts and input actions. The game has neither: the controller polls raw keys. Moving to it is a gameplay input change outside this lane, and the brief says settings save through `USupercutUserSettings`. So the bindings live there.\n- **`USupercutUserSettings` will conflict with main.** Lane dlss2 added DLSS there; I added the crosshair, audio, video, accessibility and key fields, getters, setters and `SetToDefaults` lines. Keep both sides.\n- **Shared files I touched:** `SupercutHUD.cpp` (crosshair block and the `DrawOverlay` call only), `SupercutCharacter.cpp` (two lines: motion blur after `SetFieldOfView`, camera shake in `UpdateCameraKicks`), `SupercutPlayerController.cpp/.h` (`ReadKeys`, `TickPick`, `MouseLook`, `TickMenu`, `BeginPlay` calls `ApplyLive`), `SupercutMenu.cpp/.h`, the Shell tests and `Script/shell1_*.txt` (the old CONTROLS screen is gone, title rows moved), `Script/ui1_*.txt` (mine).\n- **Scripted runs ignore the bindings.** A script feeds input through `RunScript`, not `ReadKeys`, so main8 does not depend on them. Scripted `key` lines still go through the engine's key state, so menu keys and the key box hear them.\n\n## Gotchas\n\n- The farm mirror keeps c4's file times. A file edited on c4 before the farm's last build looks older than its object file and is not compiled (A2's link error). Touch every changed source before each mirror.\n- Only one AutomationTool per engine copy: a package started while another lane packages fails at once. Retry after 60 s.\n- Untracked files in the worktree are mirrored and compiled.\n- Tests that copy the settings must root the copy (`AddToRoot`): an unrooted `DuplicateObject` copy was freed by garbage collection and stalled the editor for minutes (A1).\n- In a script, hovering a row chooses it: a `point` line moves the chosen row, so a following `key Down` starts from there.\n- A raw CR inside a script comment stops the script reader.\n- The editor saves scalability groups to `GEditorSettingsIni`, the game to `GGameUserSettingsIni` (`Runtime/Engine/Private/GameUserSettings.cpp:679`). Tests run in the editor.\n- Mixing colours: mix in sRGB, not linear, or a 6 % white on Ink reads mid grey.\n- Background shells end at 30 minutes; run long farm pipelines with a longer limit.\n- My shot runs do not clear the settings file, so the 720 run starts with the 1080 run's saved settings. main8 runs do clear it.\n- Practice keys (F1 to F5 with `-SupercutDev`) are not refused by the key box; binding one to an action makes it do both in a dev build.\n"

# tojpg.py <png dir> <out dir> <suffix>: every png -> jpg at most 960 wide
import sys, os
from PIL import Image
src, dst, suf = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
for n in sorted(os.listdir(src)):
    if not n.endswith('.png') or 'warmup' in n: continue
    im = Image.open(os.path.join(src, n)).convert('RGB')
    if im.width > 960:
        im = im.resize((960, round(im.height * 960 / im.width)), Image.LANCZOS)
    out = os.path.join(dst, n[:-4] + '_' + suf + '.jpg')
    im.save(out, quality=88)
    print(out)
```
